entries.title: 花園摘花：寧靜專注
entries.description: 用低垂眼神與指尖輕顫表達專注，環境音與手部特寫一起支撐寧靜感。
entries.prompt: 日光，暖色调，侧光，特写镜头，居中构图。一位拥有波浪形栗色长发的年轻女子，身穿浅蓝色吊带连衣裙，裙边饰有精致的蕾丝花边，亭亭玉立于阳光普照的花园中。她纤细的指尖轻轻捏住一片粉色玫瑰花瓣的边缘，以流畅而从容的动作，慢慢将其从花朵上摘下。摄像机紧密聚焦于她的手和花朵，捕捉到每一个细微的动作——指尖的轻微颤抖，花瓣从花茎上柔和地脱离。她的脸部在柔和的虚焦中若隐若现，双眼低垂，神情宁静而专注，嘴唇微启。她身后，一片繁盛的盛开花田——牡丹、雏菊和薰衣草——模糊成绿意与柔和色彩交织的渐变。阳光在她皮肤和连衣裙的面料上投下柔和的高光，营造出自然的容光。没有对白或人声；环境音包括树叶轻柔的沙沙声、远处鸟儿的鸣叫，以及微风拂过花瓣的声音。

entries.title: 風格情緒：悲壯孤峙
entries.description: 15 秒四鏡頭由壓抑走向爆發，人物參考與長槍、麒麟的設定先固定。
entries.prompt:
东方史诗仙侠，霸气雄浑。身披重甲的将军手持长枪，独骑一只金色麒麟，镇守两山之间的雄关关前，远处敌军黑潮压境。15 秒，节奏由沉稳压抑转为爆发。将军形象参考图1，面部神态参考图2，坐骑参考图3，音色参考音频1。
分镜1（00:00-00:03）：大远景建立镜头，24mm 广角，极低角度仰拍，摄影机静止。巍峨石拱门矗立于两山之间，门侧各立一尊风化巨型武将石雕；将军独骑金色麒麟立于门前，身形渺小却孤峙不退；远处敌军黑潮铺满旷野缓缓逼近，阴云压顶，狂风卷起漫天沙尘，残破战旗猎猎作响。
分镜2（00:03-00:06）：近景特写，85mm 长焦，浅景深。将军半张脸，额角血与尘，眼神坚定；插入握枪的手，指节发白。麒麟低吼喷出白气，金鳞泛起流动反光。将军低沉开口："此关，我守了十年。"
分镜3（00:06-00:10）：中近景略仰视，摄影机极缓推进。将军抬眼，眼底杀意翻涌，沉声道："今日，一个都别想过去。"话音落，麒麟前蹄高高扬起重重砸地。
分镜4（00:10-00:15）：摄影机沿将军 120 度弧线环绕并下沉至极低角度，转大远景。三头六臂金色法相自身后升腾而起，高过拱门，与将军动作同步；长枪顿地处炸裂出放射状裂纹，环形尘浪冲击波外扩，敌军黑潮齐齐停滞，将军与麒麟剪影立于金光之中。
风格情绪：东方史诗，IMAX 感大场面，变形宽银幕，电影感，胶片颗粒，高动态范围；悲壮、孤峙、一夫当关的压倒性威势。
负向清单：无现代元素、无字幕水印、无多余人物、避免面部畸变与穿帮、避免画面模糊与低分辨率。

entries.title: 舞會相視一笑（向前延長）
entries.description: 向前延長 15 秒時重述兩人的服裝與相視微笑，讓新增段落接回原影片。
entries.prompt: 将视频 1 向前延长 15s。角色 A 为穿黑色燕尾服、白色衬衫、黑色领结及米色马甲的深棕色短发男性，角色 B 为穿米色泡泡袖复古长裙、裙身带黑色蕾丝花边、佩戴深色水滴耳环的棕色盘发女性。舞厅内水晶吊灯光芒映照大理石地面，宾客们三两交谈持杯低语，一段悠扬的华尔兹弦乐前奏缓缓响起，人群的谈话声逐渐安静。角色 B 从舞厅一侧缓步走来，裙摆轻拂过大理石地面，目光环顾四周。角色 A 从人群中走出，穿过宾客径直来到角色 B 面前，微微欠身伸出右手，目光温柔注视着她。角色 B 垂眸浅笑，将右手轻轻搭上角色 A 的掌心，两人相视一笑，角色 A 引领角色 B 步入舞池中央，周围宾客自然后退让出空间，目光齐聚二人。角色 A 左手握住角色 B 右手举起，右手轻扶她的腰后，两人摆好华尔兹舞姿，随弦乐正拍踏出第一步，开始旋转。19 世纪宫廷舞会的典雅氛围，暖金色调。

entries.prompt:

镜头3（00:15-00:23）回归现实·车内：
行驶的车内后座视角，同一个女子侧颜，手枕在车门上，凝视着挂满雨滴的车窗外。窗外模糊的绿植与光影迅速退后，车内光线阴沉而温暖，侧面轮廓精致，极具电影情绪感，真实胶片颗粒，慢速摄影，优雅忧郁。
镜头4（00:23-00:30）最后的凝望：
极近面部特写，女子在车窗旁缓缓闭上双眼，流露出沉静而释怀的表情。雨滴在车窗玻璃上缓缓滑落，焦距逐渐转移到玻璃雨滴上，背景人物虚化，画面逐渐淡出黑屏，王家卫风格电影感，深情且流畅。

entries.title: 黑白婚禮：喜悅瞬間轉驚愕
entries.description: 在列車婚禮中安排表情與事件的反差，讓喜悅轉成驚愕有清楚的觸發點。
entries.prompt: 这是一个充满复古气息的黑白动画片段。场景设定在一节行驶的火车车厢内，一场婚礼正在进行。车厢中央，一对新人幸福地依偎在一起，他们面前的桌上摆放着一个漂亮的三层婚礼蛋糕。两侧的宾客们面带微笑，气氛温馨而欢乐。突然，火车似乎猛烈地晃动了一下。桌布瞬间被抽离，蛋糕和花束随之坠落。这突如其来的变故打破了宁静，所有人的表情从喜悦瞬间变为夸张的惊愕，身体也因惯性而摇摆，营造出一种充满戏剧性和喜剧效果的混乱场面。

entries.title: 華容道驚慌逃竄
entries.description: 讓前景記者朝鏡頭奔跑，混亂背景與手持跟拍一起製造驚慌，而不是只貼情緒標籤。
entries.prompt: 这段视频展示了公元 208年华容道的一个混乱场景。在白天的自然光线下，一位脸庞沾满泥污、身穿现代黑色外套的年轻女记者位于前景中央，她正朝着镜头惊慌失措地奔跑，神情紧张，气喘吁吁。她的表情和动作显示出极度的恐慌与不安。在她身后，大批身着深色盔甲、神色狼狈的魏军士兵也一同在泥泞的峡谷小道中仓皇逃窜，他们的动作显得凌乱而急促。随着她的奔跑，她用急促、恐慌的普通话说道：“我现在只能跟随溃败的魏军一起逃跑。”背景中的峡谷小道两旁是高耸的山壁，山壁上覆盖着稀疏的植被，被雨水冲刷得斑驳陆离。天空呈现出湛蓝色，但云层厚重，光线柔和，为整个场景增添了一丝压抑感。镜头采用低角度手持拍摄，剧烈的晃动感让观众仿佛身临其境，直面溃败的军队。画面中的每一个细节都清晰可见，从艾米沾满泥污的脸庞到魏军士兵狼狈不堪的表情，再到泥泞的小道和飞溅的泥水。整体视觉风格写实、粗粝且色调阴暗，营造出战争纪录片般的现场感；而音频则通过急促的脚步声、泥水飞溅声以及主角紧张的旁白，成功渲染出一种紧迫、绝望的氛围。在这段视频中，艾米的奔跑动作连贯而有力，每一步都显得格外艰难。她的身体微微前倾，双臂快速摆动，脚步沉重而急促。与此同时，魏军士兵们也在泥泞的小道中奋力前行，他们的盔甲在阳光下反射出微弱的光芒，但更多的是被泥土和汗水所掩盖

entries.title: 戀人對白：這一刻像夢一樣
entries.description: 雙人中景把相視、台詞與暖色舞台光一起安排，讓情緒透過互動發生。
entries.prompt: 双人对话，暖色调，日光，柔光，侧光，中景，中心构图，全景。红色背景的舞台铺着光滑的木质地板，两束聚光灯从上方斜射而下，照亮一对恋人。男人比女人略高，身穿剪裁合体的深灰色西装，面容清晰，眼神专注；女人身着酒红色长裙，发丝乌黑柔顺，随微风轻轻飘动。他双手轻捧她的脸颊，拇指缓缓摩挲她颧骨，她微微仰头，双眸含光，与他深情对视。她的长发被他的指尖轻轻拂过，发丝在光线中泛出细腻光泽。两人呼吸轻缓，身体随着无声的旋律微微贴近又分离，仿佛在静默中共舞。背景隐约传来柔和的钢琴前奏，音符如水流动。她轻启唇瓣，低声呢喃：“这一刻，像梦一样。” 他凝视着她，回应道：“但它是真的。

entries.description: 以前後延長兩秒、三秒接續原片，分別安排走近、抬頭與接雪花的動作。
entries.prompt: 以视频为中间段向前续写两秒：镜头平滑跟随，女孩向镜头缓缓走来，停下脚步，温柔地微微抬头，在冷空气中深吸一口气，嘴唇微张；以视频为中间段向后续写三秒：女孩搓完手，直视镜头，绽放出温暖灿烂的笑容。她缓缓抬起一只戴着手套的手，去接一片轻轻飘落的雪花，镜头缓慢后拉成中远景，展现阳光雪林小路，黄金时刻逆光，镜头光晕，浅景深，温暖治愈氛围。

entries.title: 多鏡頭：淚光與安慰
entries.description: 把失落到重拾希望拆成約 10 秒的分鏡，讓表情變化跟隨事件推進。
entries.prompt:
这个故事以第三人称视角，讲述一个关于放弃与重拾希望的短剧。
第1个镜头[0-3秒] 一个男孩在操场角落独自坐着，低头望着手中的信纸，随后轻轻叹气，眼神迷茫。
第2个镜头[4-6秒] 硬切转场，固定机位，聚焦男孩的眼睛，泪光闪烁，带着失落和无助。
第3个镜头[7-10秒] 硬切转场，场景转至一间简朴的教室，一个女孩神情温和坚定，走到男孩身边安慰他。

entries.title: 窗邊電話「我好想你」＋微表情
entries.description: 角色替換、音色參考與口型同步分清楚，再用眨眼、呼吸和小幅點頭配合台詞。
entries.prompt: 将图 1的男性角色无缝替换至视频 1的女生。角色坐在窗边，手持手机贴耳说话。【音色与台词】提取音频 1中的音色特征，并让角色说出以下台词："真的吗？听起来很棒！你什么时候回来啊。我好想你啊。"【口型与神态】生成的语音需精准驱动角色的口型自然开合。说话时伴随自然的眨眼、轻微的头部点动和呼吸感，面部微表情需与台词中的关怀、回忆情绪完美契合。【光影与场景】人物面部需自然接收室内暖光与窗外霓虹冷光的混合照明。背景窗外雨滴持续缓慢滑落，桌上咖啡有轻微热气升腾，人物与场景边缘融合自然，无抠图痕迹。【镜头与画质】15 秒长镜头，镜头极缓慢向前推进，画面极度稳定，电影级光影，8K 分辨率，照片级真实感。

entries.title: 人魚微表情：人類天天穿鞋？
entries.description: 10 秒直式近景以好奇眼神和微表情推進提問，重點是表演細節而非大動作。
entries.prompt:
FORMAT
Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 9:16 vertical
Style: cinematic photorealism, high-end fantasy beauty film, realistic skin and water physics, elegant and delicate
Camera: intimate close-up / medium close-up, subtle handheld movement, shallow depth of field
CHARACTER
An adult mermaid princess in her mid-20s, breathtakingly beautiful, ethereal and refined.
Long wet platinum-silver hair, pale luminous skin covered with tiny water droplets, large blue-green eyes, delicate pearl and shell accessories, subtle iridescent scales around her shoulders and collarbone.
CRITICAL ANATOMY RULE:
She is a real mermaid.
From the waist downward, her body transitions continuously into ONE complete iridescent fish tail with a large translucent tail fin.
NO human legs, NO thighs, NO knees, NO feet, NO transformation into legs at any point.
The tail remains clearly visible throughout the video.
She wears delicate pearl jewelry and translucent sea-inspired fabric around the upper body, elegant and slightly sensual but refined.
SETTING
Nighttime rocky shoreline beneath soft moonlight.
She rests half-submerged in shallow seawater beside dark wet rocks.
The ocean behind her reflects silver-blue moonlight.
Small waves move naturally around her tail and sparkling water droplets cling to her skin and hair.
0–3s
Medium close-up.
The mermaid princess is resting against a wet rock, her long shimmering tail curling naturally behind her in the water.
She notices the camera.
She slowly lifts her gaze toward the viewer with genuine curiosity, blinking once.
Her expression is innocent, thoughtful, almost as if she is studying a strange human creature.
Subtle ocean breeze moves strands of her wet hair.
3–8s
The camera slowly pushes closer.
She tilts her head slightly and looks directly into the lens.
In a soft, naturally curious female voice, she asks:
“So… humans really wear shoes every day?”
Natural realistic English lip sync.
The delivery should sound genuinely puzzled rather than seductive or theatrical.
After saying “shoes,” her eyebrows lift slightly, as though she still cannot understand the idea.
8–10s
She pauses.
Her eyes briefly glance downward, imagining human feet and shoes, then return to the camera.
A tiny amused smile appears.
Her tail fin gently flicks through the water behind her, creating a soft splash.
Hold eye contact for the final moment.
VISUAL STYLE
ultra-detailed cinematic fantasy realism
soft silver-blue moonlight
pearlescent highlights
wet skin texture
realistic water reflections
delicate facial micro-expressions
natural blinking and breathing
high-end fantasy film cinematography
85mm portrait lens feeling
shallow depth of field
soft background bokeh
romantic ocean atmosphere
AUDIO
Natural ocean waves
soft water movement
subtle nighttime sea ambience
clear intimate female voice
No background music
AVOID
human legs
human feet
split tail
two tails
tail transforming into legs
extra limbs
anime style
cartoon appearance
overacting
exaggerated seductive expressions
fast camera movement
large subtitles
text on screen

entries.title: 最後一洋：為水擋導彈的史詩情感科幻
entries.description: 15 秒科幻動作把保護最後水源的選擇與衝擊場面連起來，讓動作帶著情感目的。
entries.prompt:
15-second cinematic photorealistic sci-fi action film, 16:9.
Earth is completely dry and abandoned.
A gigantic spacecraft carries the LAST OCEAN inside a transparent spherical containment field.
The enormous blue ocean floats inside the ship like a miniature planet.
A hostile fleet suddenly attacks.
Human defense ships race around the ocean carrier, protecting it.
Enemy fighters fire missiles.
The carrier takes a direct hit.
The containment field cracks.
A colossal wave of water bursts into space.
Human fighters immediately fly around the escaping water, using their ships to protect the floating ocean from enemy weapons.
The water forms a gigantic blue sphere against the stars.
The carrier's containment system activates again and captures the ocean just before it is lost.
The fleet accelerates toward a distant green planet.
Epic emotional science fiction, crystal-clear premise, spectacular water physics in space, intense fighter combat, huge scale, dynamic camera movement, photorealistic spacecraft, dramatic lighting, no text, no logos, no anime, no cartoon.

entries.title: 首爾便利店：擁抱帶來力量（段二）
entries.description: 第二段用 20 秒的擁抱與互動延續情緒，成片與段一共用同一則原帖。
entries.prompt:
Prompt video 2 :

SCENE CONTEXT
Create a 20-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home video outside a small convenience store in Seoul. A hungry young Korean woman holding partially eaten bread breaks down while speaking to the young man beside her. His quiet reassurance makes her finally reach for him and cry in his arms. Emotional, intimate, and physically natural.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
Use the attached image as the exact opening frame and visual reference for both faces, hairstyles, clothing, seating positions, bread, wrapper, water bottle, shopping bag, bench, brick wall, and store entrance. The image controls visible details and initial object placement.

CHARACTERS
Woman: Korean, 23, beautiful natural face, tired reddened eyes, damp cheeks, loosely tied black hair with strands falling around her face. Worn beige cardigan, gray shirt, faded blue jeans, scuffed white sneakers. Her attempt to remain composed gradually gives way to trembling lips, broken speech, and genuine sobbing.

Man: Korean, 26, short black hair, navy windbreaker over a white T-shirt, dark trousers, gray sneakers. He listens attentively, responding with a serious, compassionate expression.

An off-screen friend holds the camcorder.

ENVIRONMENT
Weathered wooden bench against a red-brick wall beside an open convenience-store entrance. Woman seated on the left, man on the right. Begin with the bottle upright between them and the shopping bag behind it, matching the image. Cool overcast afternoon, soft daylight, fluorescent store lighting visible inside.

CAMERA & TEXTURE
Raw early-2000s consumer DV footage filmed by a friend: strong natural handheld shake, spontaneous imperfect framing, occasional autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, motion blur, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, and brief accidental zooms. The camera follows the activity with natural amateur movements.

The operator stands in front of the bench, slightly toward its right end. Begin at the reference framing. A hesitant short zoom follows the woman’s trembling expression. As she leans toward the man, the operator reacts slightly late, then takes half a step backward to keep their embrace visible. Preserve readable faces and gestures.

FORMAT MODE
Four timed segments with exact hard cuts at 5, 10, and 14 seconds. End at exactly 20 seconds. Keep actions and object positions continuous across cuts.

ACTION & TIMING
0–5 seconds:
The woman finishes swallowing, still holding the partially wrapped bread with both hands. She slowly raises her wet eyes toward the man. Her lower lip trembles.
In a strained Korean voice, she says, “저… 너무 힘들어요.”
She falters after the first word, trying to control her breathing. The camera makes a small, imperfect zoom toward her face.

5–10 seconds:
Tears run down her cheeks as she adds, “아무도 제 곁에 없어요.”
She lowers the bread and places it carefully on its opened wrapper on the bench to her left, freeing both hands. While listening, the man lifts the sealed bottle with his right hand and places it upright on the pavement beside his right shoe. He then moves the shopping bag from between them to the bench on his right, clearing the space.

10–14 seconds:
The man turns his torso toward her and quietly says, “제가 옆에 있을게요.”
He maintains gentle eye contact. She looks at him, draws a shaky breath, and her expression crumples. She turns toward him and begins reaching with both arms. The camera pans slightly late to follow her movement.

14–20 seconds:
She shifts closer along the bench and wraps both arms around his torso, pressing her face against his shoulder. He briefly pauses in surprise, then gently returns the embrace, one hand resting on her upper back and the other supporting her far shoulder.
Her shoulders tremble with uneven sobs; her fingers clutch the back of his windbreaker. He softly says, “울어도 괜찮아요.”
The operator takes half a step backward, causing a brief footstep shake, then holds on their seated embrace. End with her still crying against his shoulder while he quietly holds her.

AUDIO
Natural Korean dialogue exactly as written, with accurate lip-sync and distinct voices. Her speech becomes breathy and broken before turning into audible sobbing. His voice remains low and reassuring. Include wrapper rustling, jacket fabric shifting during the hug, distant traffic, faint refrigerator hum, and subtle camcorder-handling noise. No background music or narration.

CONTINUITY
Preserve the reference identities, clothing, natural skin texture, bench geography, and lighting. The bread remains partially eaten and rests on its wrapper to the woman’s left before the embrace. Move the bottle and shopping bag visibly before she shifts closer; they remain in their new positions. Both characters stay seated. Her hands are empty during the hug. Maintain realistic arm placement, body contact, accumulating tears, and natural breathing without exaggerated theatrical movements. Fully photorealistic live action. No slow motion, beauty filters, stylized lighting, subtitles, added text, logos, or watermark.

entries.title: 首爾便利店：淚水與孤獨（段一）
entries.description: 第一段以 30 秒的人物動作與情緒細節建立孤獨感，不把兩段提示詞合成一條。
entries.prompt:
Prompt video 1 :

SCENE CONTEXT
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home video capturing a quiet, heartbreaking encounter in an older Seoul neighborhood. A beautiful young Korean woman, exhausted and hungry, sits outside a small convenience store. A young Korean man notices her and shares his food. Her restrained reaction carries the emotion: embarrassment, disbelief, then relief at being treated kindly.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
Text-only generation. The written descriptions define the consistent characters, objects, and locations throughout.

CHARACTERS
Woman: Korean, 23, naturally beautiful, pale tired face, slightly chapped lips, long black hair loosely tied back with stray strands around her cheeks. Worn beige cardigan over a plain gray shirt, faded blue jeans, scuffed white sneakers. Natural skin texture, no glamorous makeup. She moves slowly and avoids eye contact, trying to hide her hunger.

Man: Korean, 26, short black hair, gentle expression, navy windbreaker, white T-shirt, dark trousers, gray sneakers. His concern is expressed through patient, ordinary gestures.

His off-screen friend holds the camcorder, initially recording their walk.

ENVIRONMENT
An older Seoul residential alley on a cool, overcast afternoon. A small convenience store faces the pavement; a weathered wooden bench stands beside its entrance, with a red-brick wall behind it. The woman sits at the left end. The man approaches from the right carrying one small transparent shopping bag containing one wrapped bread roll and one sealed water bottle. Soft daylight, distant neighborhood traffic, a faint refrigerator hum from the open store entrance.

CAMERA & TEXTURE
Raw early-2000s consumer DV footage filmed by a friend: strong natural handheld shake, spontaneous imperfect framing, occasional autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, motion blur, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, and brief accidental zooms. The camera follows the activity with natural amateur movements.

The friend begins one step behind the man, then stops near the bench’s right end, leaving the woman space. Walking creates visible footstep shake. When the man stops unexpectedly, the camera briefly drifts past him before correcting. Later details are captured with one hesitant short zoom. Keep the interaction readable and quietly observed.

FORMAT MODE
Five timed home-video segments with exact hard cuts at 6, 12, 18, and 24 seconds. End at exactly 30 seconds. Preserve the same bench, character positions, clothing, food, and bag across cuts.

ACTION & TIMING
0–6 seconds:
The camera follows behind the man approaching the store. On the bench, the woman searches an empty cardigan pocket, then lowers her hand into her lap. She notices the bread through his shopping bag; her gaze lingers before she quickly looks down, embarrassed. He notices and stops. The operator takes one extra step, then corrects the framing.

6–12 seconds:
From beside the bench, a slightly crooked medium shot. The man bends his knees to meet her eye level without crowding her. Holding the bag in his left hand, he retrieves the wrapped bread with his right and gently offers it.
He quietly says in Korean, “이거 드세요.”
She looks from the bread to his face, hesitating, then accepts it with both hands. He releases it only once her grip is secure.

12–18 seconds:
The man sits at the bench’s right end, leaving a respectful gap. He places the bag on the bench to his right, removes the sealed water bottle, and sets it upright between them.
The woman rests the bread on her lap and peels back the wrapper with trembling fingers. The camera makes a small imperfect zoom toward her hands; autofocus briefly searches, then settles. She lifts the partially wrapped bread and takes one small bite.

18–24 seconds:
A closer, imperfectly framed view of her face. She chews slowly and swallows. Her shoulders loosen, but her eyes fill with tears. She pauses with the bread held over her lap, presses her lips together, and wipes one cheek with her free hand.
In a barely steady voice, she says, “감사합니다.”
The camera holds quietly, with subtle hand tremor.

24–30 seconds:
A wider view includes both of them. He gives a small reassuring nod and says softly, “천천히 드세요.”
He then looks toward the alley, giving her privacy. She takes another small bite, holding the wrapper beneath the bread to catch crumbs. Her gaze drops, tears still visible, but her breathing settles. End on both sitting quietly together, the untouched water bottle standing between them.

AUDIO
Natural Korean dialogue only as specified. Distant passing vehicles, faint footsteps, refrigerator hum, bread-wrapper rustling, quiet breathing, and subtle camcorder-handling noise. Her voice is fragile and restrained; his voice is gentle and conversational. No background music or narration.

CONTINUITY
Maintain consistent faces, ages, hairstyles, clothing, and footwear. One bread roll transfers from the man’s bag to the woman and remains partially wrapped; each bite visibly reduces it. One water bottle remains sealed and upright between them. The shopping bag stays at the man’s right after being placed there. Preserve realistic hands, chewing, swallowing, restrained tears, and the bench’s geography. Use ordinary overcast daylight throughout. Fully photorealistic live action; no stylized lighting, slow motion, beauty filters, subtitles, added text, logos, or watermark.

entries.title: 迷你悲傷短劇 My player 2：離別空擊掌
entries.description: 場景是夜晚客廳沙發上的雙人打電動，以 30 秒不間斷運鏡和碰不到的擊掌表達離別。
entries.prompt:
Photoreal cinematic short, 30 seconds, one unbroken camera move, 24–30fps, natural indoor lighting mixed with TV glow. No cuts, no gore, no blood, no logos. No burned-in subtitles. All lines are spoken, not written on screen.

Setting: a small lived-in apartment at night. Couch facing a large TV. Two controllers. Soft lamp. Half-finished snacks. A second headset on the cushion. On the TV: a bright third-person co-op fantasy game, split or shared screen, two adventurers running together through glowing ruins.

Characters in the room:
Player 1 — young man, hoodie, focused then laughing, left side of the couch.
Player 2 — young woman on his right, same age, casual clothes, laughing with him, second controller, leaning into his shoulder when they win.

00:00–00:08
Start on the TV: both in-game characters sprint and tag-team a small monster. Camera slowly pulls back from the screen to the couch. The couple cheers. He shouts at a jump. She bumps his arm, grinning, mashing buttons. While they play he talks to her, excited: “We’re so good together. Look at that combo. Nobody plays like us.” She laughs and keeps playing. They look at each other, not just the screen. Warm co-op night. On the TV her avatar stays fully present the whole time.

00:08–00:16
They clear a checkpoint. In-game victory chime. Her character is still fully in the game, running beside his. He keeps talking to her: “That was perfect. You’re carrying us. We still got it.” She raises the controller like a trophy. He laughs. They turn toward each other for a high-five / clap.

00:16–00:24
This is the transition. He swings his hand in for the clap. In the first part of the motion she is still there, smiling, hand coming up to meet his. Mid-clap she fades from the couch: her hand first, then her body, until his palm hits empty air. No one is on the right seat. One body print. Second controller rests unused, battery light dark. Headset unused.
Rule for the game screen: Player 2’s avatar remains in the game for as long as the girl is still visible on the couch. The instant she is fully gone from the room, her adventurer fades out of the game and the slot goes empty. Not before.

00:24–00:30
His smile stalls. He stares at the empty space where her hand should have been. Quietly, broken, he says: “I wish you are still here.” The camera drifts to a small framed photo of the girl on the side table. A single candle burns in front of it, warm light on her face. He sets his controller down. Hold on the candlelit photo, empty seat behind it, co-op screen now showing only Player 1. No cause of death. No grave. No hospital.

Audio: co-op music, his talk about how well they play, her laugh, two controllers, then music thins after the missed clap, her voice gone, one controller, fridge hum, distant traffic, leftover victory chime, candle flicker, his last line.

Do not include: gore, wounds, funeral, jump-scare ghost face, horror makeup, first-person death footage, guns, on-screen logos.

entries.title: Bon Voyage 世界地標時尚旅行片
entries.description: 15 秒正方形片從拼貼海報進入地標，四格匹配剪接與角色參考分區寫；原帖另有三模型比較。
entries.prompt:
[DECLARATION]
15秒・1:1スクエア。
HIGH-END CINEMATIC FASHION TRAVEL FILM。完成済みのヴィンテージ・コラージュポスターから現実世界へ入り、世界の名所を巡り、途中でパリにいる女性のファッション・マッチカットを挟み、最後に元のポスターへ帰還する映像。

[REFERENCE]
<image1> は完成済みVOYAGEポスター。冒頭と終盤の完成ポスター全体、人物、文字、建築コラージュ、配色、世界観の参照とする。
<image2> は全身人物アンカー。現実世界に登場する女性の顔、髪型、髪色、体型、黒いハイネック寄りのノースリーブトップス、腹部の肌見せ、黒×オフホワイトの大柄な幾何学模様のワイドパンツ、黒い厚底靴を固定する。

[CONDITION]
全編を通して同一人物、同一体型、同一衣装を維持する。現実世界はフォトリアルな実写表現。ランドマークは短時間でも誰でも分かる象徴的な構図で見せるが、観光写真のような静止に近いショットにはしない。各ランドマークは、短い尺の中でもテンポが出るよう、明確なカメラ移動、前景の流れ、視差、通過感を持たせる。軽い前進だけで終わらせず、横移動、斜め移動、すり抜け感、カーブ移動などを使い、各場所で動きの性格を変える。
女性はパリで1回だけまとまって登場し、ファッション性を見せる4カットのマッチカットとして扱う。同じ場所に固定する必要はなく、パリの中で成立する複数の背景や立ち位置を使ってよい。ただし、4カット全体は同じ人物・同じ衣装・同じ世界観の連続したファッション編集として見せる。マッチカットは、同じ女性を異なる画角と角度でリズミカルに切り替えることを重視し、背景の完全一致よりも、人物の存在感、シルエット、衣装の見せ方、画面内でのつながりを優先する。Shot 4 と Shot 5 は全身を完全に収め、Shot 6 は上半身、Shot 7 は顔寄りとして役割を明確に分ける。
冒頭と終盤のポスターは、まずヴィンテージ紙の質感を持つ背景があり、その上に完成済みのVOYAGEポスターが置かれている状態として見せる。ポスターは完成した平面デザインとして扱い、ポスター内の女性、文字、彫刻、建築コラージュ、切れ目を含めて完成形のまま明確に見せる。背景は背景、ポスターはポスターとして区別し、背景がポスター内部の彫刻や建築、紙の切れ目を補完したり、続きを生成したりしない。白い無地余白や不自然な額装感は出さない。終盤も、人物を含んだ完成済みポスター全体へ明確に戻る。
現実世界の全ショットは快晴の昼間。鮮明な青空、澄んだ大気、明るく透明感のある自然光、自然で豊かな色彩を維持する。曇天、雨上がりのくすみ、黄ばんだ空気感、灰色がかった街並みを避ける。川や水面が画面に入る場合は、濁った黄色い水にせず、青空を自然に反射する清潔な水面にする。ロンドンでも暗く湿った印象にせず、明るく抜けの良い日中の街並みとして見せる。

[SHOT FLOW]

Shot 1｜0.00~1.70秒
ヴィンテージ紙の質感を持つ背景の上に、完成済みVOYAGEポスターが大きく置かれている。ポスター内の女性、VOYAGEの文字、彫刻、建築コラージュ、切れ目を含む完成デザイン全体が明確に見える。背景は背景として存在し、ポスター内部の要素を補完しない。左側の大きな「VOYAGE」が一瞬だけ光を放ち、微細に揺れる。直後にカメラがポスター内の女性の顔へ高速ズームし、片目のクローズアップまで一気に接近する。目が画面いっぱいに映った状態で終了する。

Shot 2｜1.70~3.00秒
直前の目のクローズアップからハードカットで快晴のロンドンへ切り替わる。ビッグ・ベンとウェストミンスター宮殿が明確に見える昼間の街並み。カメラは街路や橋のラインを使いながら、やや見上げ気味に斜め前方へ素早く移動する。象徴的な時計塔が明確に読めるようにしつつ、前景や周辺の流れで通過感を出す。もし川や水面が入る場合は、濁った黄色い水ではなく、青空を自然に反射する穏やかな水面にする。

Shot 3｜3.00~4.30秒
快晴のパリ。エッフェル塔が明確に見える街並み。カメラは柵、街路、欄干などの前景をかすめながら、横方向へ流れるように素早く移動し、エッフェル塔を印象的に見せる。観光写真のような静止感ではなく、パリを通過しているようなテンポを出す。

Shot 4｜4.30~5.10秒
パリで女性のマッチカット1。パリらしい街路または広場。カメラは人物から十分に距離を取った正面の全身ロングショット。頭頂と黒い厚底靴の靴底の上下に明確な余白を確保し、両腕、パンツの裾まで全身を画面内に完全に収める。人物は画面中央付近に配置し、幾何学柄のワイドパンツと厚底靴を含む衣装全体を見せる。

Shot 5｜5.10~5.90秒
パリで女性のマッチカット2。Shot 4 から瞬間的なハードカット。カメラは人物の真横に近い位置へ大きく角度を変えたサイド全身ロングショット。正面とは明確に異なる横方向の輪郭と、ワイドパンツの立体的な広がりを見せる。人物全体が収まる距離を維持し、頭頂から厚底靴まで上下左右に余白を確保する。背景は別のパリらしい場所でもよい。女性は同じ衣装と自然な立ち姿を保つ。

Shot 6｜5.90~6.70秒
パリで女性のマッチカット3。Shot 5 から瞬間的なハードカット。カメラを女性の斜め前方へ切り替え、腰から頭頂までを収めた3/4斜めのミディアムショット。顔、肩、黒いハイネックトップス、腰のラインを明確に見せる。頭頂に余白を確保し、人物が画面端へはみ出さない。サイド全身から斜め上半身へ、角度と距離が明確に変化するファッションカットとする。

Shot 7｜6.70~7.50秒
パリで女性のマッチカット4。Shot 6 から瞬間的なハードカット。反対側の斜め前方から撮影した顔のクローズアップ。頭頂と顎を画面内に収め、顔の輪郭、髪型、視線、表情を明確に見せる。前カットとは異なる撮影角度で立体的な顔立ちを印象づける。背景は柔らかくぼかしたパリの街並み。4カット全体を明確な画角とカメラ角度の変化で構成する。

Shot 8｜7.50~9.50秒
快晴のニューヨーク。自由の女神が明確に見える昼間の風景。カメラは直線的でややスピーディーな移動を行い、ヨーロッパとは異なる都市の空気感を出す。誰でもすぐ認識できる構図で、短く力強く見せる。

Shot 9｜9.50~12.00秒
快晴のローマ。コロッセオが大きく見える昼間の街並み。カメラはややカーブしながら前進し、古代ローマの象徴的な建築を見せる。終盤に向けて、実景の質感が少しずつヴィンテージ印刷写真のような質感へ移行し始める。

Shot 10｜12.00~15.00秒
ローマの建築風景がヴィンテージ紙の質感を持つ背景へ移行する。その上に、人物を含んだ完成済みVOYAGEポスター全体が大きく明確に現れる。ポスター内の女性、VOYAGEの文字、彫刻、建築コラージュ、切れ目を含む完成デザイン全体をそのまま見せる。背景は背景として存在し、ポスター内部の要素を補完したり続きを生成したりしない。白い無地余白や不自然な額装感は出さない。画面中央に完成ポスターがはっきり見えた直後、左側の「VOYAGE」が冒頭と同じように一瞬だけ発光して微細に揺れる。光が収まり、完成済みポスターを静止状態で見せて終了する。

[SOUND]
全編に洗練されたアップテンポのエレクトロニック・ファッションビートをBGMとして流す。インストゥルメンタル、ボーカルなし。ポスター文字の発光に短い電子的な光の効果音。冒頭の高速ズームには鋭い風切り音。各ランドマークには控えめな都市の環境音。ローマからポスターへの帰還には柔らかい紙の重なりと印刷的な効果音。

[NEGATIVE]
別人化、衣装変更、人物の複製、顔や身体の変形、ランドマークの混同、不要な文字生成、現実世界へのポスター装飾の混入、ポスター本体の文字やレイアウト変更、黒画面の挿入。
曇天、雨天、黄ばんだ空、灰色や黄褐色にくすんだ映像、濁った黄色い川、汚れた水面、現実世界へのセピア色の混入。
観光写真のような静止に近いランドマークショット、カフェの反復、飲食動作、座り姿。
ポスターの不自然な縮小、額装のような見せ方、白い無地余白、腹部など不自然な位置に目が出現する破綻、瞳内部の不自然な変形。

entries.title: 耳無芳一：怪談真人短劇
entries.description: 30 秒 16:9 怪談先固定古寺與幽靈舞台，再讓人物和光影承接敘事。
entries.prompt:
30秒短劇，16:9，電影感，12世紀末鎌倉時代日本古風，電影級光影。

場景： 鎌倉時代日本古寺、極其華麗的平家幽靈舞台（金箔、華麗燈籠、精美屏風、在蓮花池邊）、深夜山寺，氛圍先奇幻曖昧再轉恐怖。

角色：  
ほういち（芳一）：年輕英俊盲眼僧人，精瘦結實身材、兩眼皆盲角膜泛灰白、光頭。穿素色僧衣（後轉只穿白色兜襠布）。  
白衣女鬼：蒼白長黑髮，穿華麗12世紀日本女官和服（層層鮮豔顏色、精美刺繡、華麗髮飾）。  
黑盔甲女鬼將軍與貴族女鬼：黑甲與極其華麗的平家貴族女官和服。  
老和尚：年長僧人，長白眉、長白鬍鬚，穿深色僧衣。

風格： 電影級打光，淺景深，先奇幻浪漫再陰森恐怖，膠片質感，節奏極快。

第一段（0-15秒）：  
0-1s：夜晚古寺內，ほういち彈奏琵琶，村民們滿足聆聽。  
1-2s：末排一位華麗女官和服白衣女鬼(身上冒著淡淡的黑色煙霧)滿意點頭。  
2-3s：當晚寺廟寢室，ほういち躺下，準備睡覺。  
3-4s：白衣女鬼跪在寢室的門外請求：「Please play for us.」  
4-5s：白衣女鬼拉著ほういち的手，走上蓮花池邊極其華麗的平家舞台。  
5-7s：ほういち高速彈奏古曲，台下的黑盔甲女鬼將軍與華麗貴族女鬼們驚嘆。  
7-9s：貴族女鬼們曖昧挑逗ほういち——輕摸他光頭、長舌輕舔他唇、在他耳邊吹氣。  
9-11s：ほういち生氣拒絕：「Stop! Send me back please.」  
11-13s：ほういち睡在寢室夜夜惡夢，窗外華麗女鬼呼喊「ほういち…」。  
13-14s：老和尚（長白眉白鬚）經過走廊撞見寢室內ほういち說夢話的痛苦模樣。  
14-15s：早晨，老和尚在ほういち全身（除耳朵）寫滿紅色經文。
15-16s：夜晚，全身(雙耳除外)寫滿紅色經文的ほういち只穿兜襠布在寺廟寢室內打坐。  
16-18s：華麗女鬼們湧入，紛紛淒厲呼喚：「ほういち…ほういち…」  
18-19s：ほういち心跳加速，胸口劇烈起伏。  
19-21s：ほういち全身冒汗，紅色經文被汗水稍微溶解。  
21-22s：女鬼們靠近，然而——房間裡完全看不到芳一的身體。只有一對「孤零零、漂浮在黑暗中的耳朵」。女鬼們愣住。鏡頭快速推近漂浮的雙耳。紅色經文在其他身體部位完全隱形，只有耳朵暴露。
22-23s：數名女鬼同時撲向漂浮的雙耳。黑色長髮瘋狂飛舞。
帶頭女鬼伸出冰冷的手，說“Found you.” 她猛然抓住雙耳。
畫面只看到漂浮的雙耳被強行扯下。鮮血在黑暗中濺開。
23-24s：帶頭女鬼拎著血淋淋的雙耳，發出詭異的笑聲，與其他女鬼們一起快速飛走。
24-26s：早晨，老和尚滿臉擔憂，快步衝進寢室。  
26-28s：老和尚發現只穿兜襠布且沒有耳朵的ほういち正痛苦跪著掙扎，失去雙耳的周圍臉部皮膚血淋淋。  老和尚擔憂地問：「ほういち…You okay? 」 
28-30s：鏡頭定格在ほういち那失去雙耳的痛苦蒼白臉孔，以及他的痛苦喘息聲，畫面fade into black。

entries.title: 中年女性哭訴特寫：5 秒情緒戲
entries.description: 固定近景細寫眼眶、鼻尖與面部肌肉反應，並限制磨皮、臉漂移和舞台感。
entries.prompt:
生成5秒写实剧情短片，16:9，24fps，轻微胶片颗粒，室内昏暗房间，柔和侧逆光，氛围感压抑悲伤。
人物：中年中国女性，黑长发，朴素日常上衣，胸部以上近景，固定机位，镜头几乎不动。全程连续说话，不停哭诉，眼泪不断顺着脸颊往下流，眼眶红肿，鼻尖泛红，嘴唇不停开合，伴随哽咽、细微肩膀抖动，面部肌肉真实抽搐，委屈痛苦，口型和中文语音严格同步，5秒全程铺满台词，没有空白。

【时间轴 0.0‑5.0秒】
0‑5秒全程持续哭诉，不停讲话，泪珠持续滑落，呼吸断断续续带哽咽
女人带着哭腔持续说道：“我到底做错了什么，为什么要这么对我……”

声音设计：原生中文人声，带哭腔哽咽，有抽泣换气，无背景音乐，只有极轻室内环境底噪。
硬性禁止：字幕、水印、logo、夸张嘶吼、舞台表演感、美颜磨皮、面部漂移变形、口型错位、黑屏淡出。5秒结束直接截断画面。

entries.title: 和製《站在我這邊》8mm 家庭錄影
entries.description: 30 秒一鏡用不完美手持、片門晃動與褪色暖調，串起少年鐵道探險。
entries.prompt:
Unplanned handheld 8mm home-movie recording, shot by an older teenage brother moving with the group, imperfect framing, warm faded film colors, visible fine grain, slight gate weave, occasional motion blur, natural summer daylight, realistic deep focus.

Characters:

The hero is a thirteen-year-old Japanese boy with slightly overgrown black hair, wearing a faded white baseball shirt with red piping, navy shorts, worn canvas sneakers and a red cloth shoulder bag.

His three friends: a stocky boy wearing a yellow baseball cap and striped T-shirt, a thin boy with round glasses wearing a pale-blue short-sleeved shirt, and a smaller energetic boy wearing a white sleeveless shirt and khaki shorts.

They carry insect nets, metal canteens, flashlights and a hand-drawn treasure map folded inside an old school notebook.

They tease one another, argue over directions and laugh loudly as they travel together.

Setting:

Rural Japan during the late Shōwa era, summer of 1978 — green rice fields, narrow country roads, wooden houses with tiled roofs, concrete utility poles, rusted road signs and distant forested mountains.

An abandoned local railway line runs beyond a weathered crossing, disappearing through tall grass into a dark railway tunnel.

Beyond the tunnel stands a forgotten wooden signal cabin beside a shallow river, surrounded by cicadas, weeds and golden late-afternoon sunlight.

No modern objects, no contemporary buildings, no smartphones, no modern cars, no LED signs.

Shot list:

0.0s–4.0s — Wide tracking shot, waist height, camera moving beside the group
The four boys race old Japanese bicycles along a narrow road between bright green rice fields, shouting and laughing as their shirts flutter in the summer wind; the handheld camera struggles to keep pace while cicadas roar and bicycle bells ring.

4.0s–7.0s — Medium-wide, eye level, sudden stop and loose reframe
They skid to a stop at a rusted abandoned railway crossing. The hero jumps off his bicycle, pulls the folded hand-drawn map from his shoulder bag and points toward the overgrown railway tracks while the others gather around him.

7.0s–10.0s — Rear tracking shot, low angle, uneven handheld movement
The boys leave their bicycles hidden in the tall grass and run along the disused tracks, balancing on the rails and pushing one another playfully; their insect nets and metal canteens bounce as the camera follows from behind.

10.0s–13.0s — Medium shot, entering darkness, natural exposure shift
They reach the mouth of an old railway tunnel and slow down. The hero switches on a flashlight, raises it above his head and leads the group inside as the bright summer landscape behind them rapidly fades into darkness.

13.0s–16.0s — Close handheld group shot inside the tunnel
The flashlight beam shakes across damp brick walls while the boys walk closely together, trying to act brave. A sudden flutter of birds erupts from the ceiling, making all four scream, duck and then burst into embarrassed laughter.

16.0s–19.0s — Wide shot, camera following them out of the tunnel
They run from the tunnel into brilliant golden sunlight and stop in surprise. Below them lies a sparkling river, an old wooden signal cabin and a forgotten railway platform almost completely covered by summer grass.

19.0s–22.0s — Medium tracking shot, running downhill
The hero checks the map, spots the signal cabin and races toward it. His friends chase him through waist-high grass while the camera follows with excited unstable framing and brief flashes of sunlight across the lens.

22.0s–25.0s — Close medium, crouched handheld angle
Inside the dusty signal cabin, the hero kneels beside a loose wooden floorboard and pulls out a rusted metal lunchbox. The four boys crowd around as he opens it, revealing old glass marbles, a brass compass and a faded black-and-white photograph.

25.0s–28.0s — Tight group shot, drifting between faces
The boys quietly examine the small objects. Their excitement becomes a shared look of wonder as the brass compass catches the warm sunlight; the smallest boy smiles and whispers something while the others nod.

28.0s–30.0s — Wide rear shot, camera settles
The four boys sit side by side on the abandoned platform with their backs toward the camera, looking across the river and distant mountains as the summer sun begins to set; the hero holds the brass compass in his hand while their bicycles remain far behind beyond the tunnel.

Audio:

Natural location sound accompanying the footage — loud cicadas, bicycle chains, rattling metal canteens, boys shouting and joking in casual Japanese, sneakers striking wooden sleepers, echoing footsteps inside the tunnel, startled screams, fluttering wings, flowing river water, distant train whistle and warm summer wind moving through the grass.

The Japanese conversation is spontaneous and overlapping, mostly indistinct except for short reactions and laughter.

No music.

Style:

Raw amateur late-1970s Japanese 8mm home-movie footage, nostalgic but realistic, warm sun-faded colors, fine analog grain, mild flicker, occasional overexposure, imperfect focus, natural handheld movement and authentic childhood spontaneity.

A grounded coming-of-age summer adventure about friendship, curiosity and the final days of childhood.

No polished commercial cinematography, no modern fashion, no fantasy elements, no supernatural effects, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

entries.title: 倫敦蘇活區夜遊情侶
entries.description: 以照片鎖定兩人的外觀，要求每場同時在畫面內，夜景下也保持自然膚質。
entries.prompt:
LONDON AFTER DARK | 15-Second Cinematic City Tour | WAN 3

Character & Visual Continuity
Begin with the exact supplied Soho couple reference image as the opening frame. Preserve both characters’ facial identities, hairstyles, natural skin texture, proportions, and outfits throughout. The man wears a fitted ivory henley, black jeans, and necklace. The woman wears a charcoal off-shoulder top, brown shorts, black tights, and carries a black handbag. Their chemistry is natural, romantic, and understated. Both protagonists remain visible in every scene.

Scene 1 — Soho, Wardour Street (0–2.5s)

Open on the supplied image. Both characters make direct eye contact with the camera for less than one second, then exchange a smile and begin walking together. His arm moves naturally from her waist as the camera tracks backward at close range. Neon bar signs, authentic London storefronts, and lively pedestrians fill the background.

Scene 2 — Carnaby Street (2.5–5s)

Hard cut to Carnaby Street beneath its illuminated overhead decorations. A lateral tracking shot follows the couple past busy shops and groups of friends. She playfully takes his hand and pulls him toward a storefront. He laughs and follows, maintaining natural movement and believable chemistry.

Scene 3 — Piccadilly Circus (5–7.5s)

Hard cut to Piccadilly Circus, with its recognizable illuminated advertising screens and red double-decker buses passing behind them. A dynamic close-range camera pass captures the couple pausing at a pedestrian crossing. She turns toward him and says something playful. He smiles as they continue across the street with surrounding pedestrians.

Scene 4 — Leicester Square (7.5–10s)

Hard cut to Leicester Square, surrounded by illuminated cinemas, restaurants, and active nightlife. A street performer entertains a small gathering nearby. The couple briefly turn toward the performance, exchange amused glances, and continue walking shoulder to shoulder. The camera tracks them from a medium-close angle, keeping the background active and authentic.

Scene 5 — South Bank, River Thames (10–12.5s)

Hard cut to the Thames riverside promenade, with the illuminated London Eye visible across the water. The couple walk hand in hand as the camera glides laterally beside them. He turns toward her, and she responds with a spontaneous smile. Reflections shimmer across the river while pedestrians move naturally through the background.

Scene 6 — Westminster Bridge (12.5–15s)

Hard cut to Westminster Bridge, with illuminated Big Ben and the Palace of Westminster clearly recognizable behind them. The couple stop close together. He gently wraps an arm around her waist, and she leans toward him. The camera makes a subtle curved movement into an intimate medium-close portrait. They exchange a brief glance before looking directly toward the camera. End on a confident, natural cinematic frame.

Cinematography & Direction
Six distinct scenes connected by clean, motivated hard cuts. Alternate backward tracking, lateral movement, close-range camera passes, and subtle curved camera movement. Keep both protagonists prominent in every shot. Avoid repetitive head-to-toe camera scans, static posing, excessive wide shots, and zooms.

Capture authentic London nightlife through recognizable architecture, British street signage, left-side traffic, red buses, active pedestrians, and believable street interactions. Every location should feel naturally populated without distracting from the couple.

Maintain consistent nighttime lighting with realistic neon illumination, warm storefront lighting, natural shadows, and accurate reflections. Preserve detailed skin texture, believable facial expressions, realistic walking mechanics, and consistent character identities.

Each new location appears through a clean cut, never through teleportation or morphing. No artificial slow motion, distorted hands, unnatural gestures, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, or animated appearance.

Audio: Natural London nightlife ambience, footsteps, passing traffic, background conversations, and brief spontaneous dialogue between the couple. No generated music.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic cinematic street photography, intimate editorial fashion-film aesthetics, dynamic camera movement, natural human interactions, and authentic London atmosphere. Total duration: 15 seconds.

entries.title: 阿拉木圖晨間城市導覽
entries.description: 22 秒六場硬切中，首三秒鎖死原圖樓梯與背景，並排除閃白、瞬移和音樂。
entries.prompt:
ALMATY, KAZAKHSTAN — MORNING CITY TOUR V3

22 seconds, 16:9, WAN 3. 

Six scenes, HARD CUTS ONLY. No flashes, fades or dissolves. Hyper-realistic morning in Almaty. Preserve the reference man's exact face, beard, brown beanie, tan jacket, gray hoodie, jeans and sneakers. Natural crowds, motion and light.

SCENE 1 (0–3s) — EXACT REFERENCE LOCATION
Begin on the supplied image. For ALL three seconds preserve the SAME concrete stairs, dark railings, concrete pillars, bushes, stickered walls, red circular sign with white writing, white numbered signs including 656, and sidewalk. Do not replace, rebuild or transform this background; no tree-lined street. He makes eye contact under one second, then walks naturally through this SAME location as camera tracks gently. Opening title appears ONLY here, two lines:

Almaty, Kazakhstan
Morning City Tour
At 3s hard cut; title vanishes instantly.

SCENE 2 (3–6s) — ASCENSION CATHEDRAL
Lateral medium tracking as he walks past the colorful wooden cathedral in Panfilov Park, briefly glancing toward it. Visitors behind him, natural sunshine. No text.

SCENE 3 (6–9s) — ZHIBEK ZHOLY CAFÉ
A barista hands him takeaway coffee. He accepts, smiles and says Kazakh: “Рақмет.” English subtitle: “Thank you.” Natural handoff and lip-sync. Camera tracks him leaving with the cup.

SCENE 4 (9–14s) — GREEN BAZAAR BUTCHER
Medium-close two-shot at a busy meat counter, showing both faces and beef cuts. He asks in Kazakh: “Бүгін не жақсы?” Subtitle: “What's good today?” Butcher maintains eye contact, gestures to beef ribs and replies in Kazakh: “Бүгін сиырдың қабырға еті жақсы.” Subtitle: “The beef ribs are excellent today.” Let subtitle remain for a brief reading beat. The man STAYS at the counter, smiles and nods in understanding while the butcher remains engaged. Neither turns or walks away. Then HARD CUT. No fruit.

SCENE 5 (14–18s) — REPUBLIC SQUARE
Low-angle tracking as he walks with the Independence Monument behind him, adjusting his beanie while holding coffee. Pedestrians move naturally. No text.

SCENE 6 (18–22s) — CENTRAL ALMATY CAFÉ STREET
Busy pedestrian sidewalk with outdoor café seating, storefronts and locals. Angled front-side medium view. He walks LEFT to RIGHT on the sidewalk, happy and relaxed; sips coffee, lowers cup, smiles, then fully EXITS frame right. Hold briefly and end with clean cut. No roadway walking, no final title. Storefront text must be realistic, stable and legible: use a simple red sign with credible Kazakh lettering, a green-and-white café or shop sign with correctly spelled words, and replace the nonsensical “HHRIHM” sign with “CAFE” in the same white lettering and style. No random symbols or invented brands.

SUBTITLES — ONE DESIGN THROUGHOUT
Poppins SemiBold 600, white #FFFFFF on softly rounded charcoal-slate #17212B at 60% opacity. Background translucent; consistent padding, bottom-center position and safe margins. entries.description: 以亂髮、疲憊眼神與不完美構圖寫生活感，同一提示詞另與 Seedance 2.5 比較。
entries.prompt:
Seoul Summer Day - Video Prompt

Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic documentary-style personal home video showing an ordinary summer day in the life of a young Korean man. The footage should feel spontaneous, intimate, imperfect, and genuinely observed rather than performed.

MAIN SUBJECT

The same young Korean man in his early 20s throughout the entire video.

Naturally handsome, realistic skin texture, minimal styling, relaxed expression, slightly tired but peaceful eyes.

He has naturally messy medium-length dark hair with a few strands falling over his forehead and very subtle stubble.

He wears a loose washed-black T-shirt, relaxed olive-beige trousers, worn white sneakers, and a simple silver wristwatch.

Keep his face, identity, body proportions, hairstyle, clothing, watch, and overall appearance completely consistent from beginning to end.

LOCATION

A quiet older residential neighborhood in Seoul during a warm summer afternoon.

Narrow concrete alleys, low-rise homes, rooftop terraces, external staircases, potted plants, laundry lines, parked bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, mature trees, concrete walls, small residential courtyards, and distant city sounds.

The neighborhood should feel authentic and lived-in.
No crowds, tourist attractions, advertisements, recognizable brands, or commercial activity.

CAMERA / VISUAL STYLE

Authentic casual personal-video footage captured with an older consumer digital camera.

Handheld camera operated by a friend walking nearby.
Natural camera shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus changes, slight exposure adjustments when moving between sunlight and shade, soft image detail, mild motion blur, subtle digital noise, slightly muted colors, imperfect white balance, and natural compression.

The camera operator occasionally reacts a little late, cuts off part of the subject, or briefly loses focus.

No stabilization, gimbal movement, drone shots, cinematic camera choreography, dramatic lighting, slow motion, modern commercial color grading, or polished cinematography.

The footage should feel like someone simply decided to record his friend during an ordinary day.

00:00–00:05 — MORNING ROOFTOP
He sits casually on a small rooftop beside an old plastic chair.
A cold bottled drink rests beside him.
He looks quietly across the neighborhood while the wind moves his hair and T-shirt.
He takes a sip, notices something happening in the distance, and smiles faintly.
He briefly notices the camera and gives a subtle nod before looking away.
The camera takes a moment to find focus on his face.

00:05–00:10 — WALKING THROUGH THE ALLEY
He gets up and walks downstairs into the neighborhood.
He walks casually through a narrow concrete alley with his hands in his pockets.
He passes parked bicycles, potted plants, laundry hanging from balconies, and old residential walls.
The camera follows several steps behind him.
He occasionally looks back toward the camera but never deliberately poses.
His footsteps remain naturally synchronized with his movement.

00:10–00:14 — SMALL EVERYDAY MOMENT
He notices an old basketball resting near a wall.
He picks it up, casually bounces it twice, then takes a simple shot toward a nearby hoop.
The shot misses.

He laughs quietly, shakes his head, and leaves the ball where he found it.

The camera briefly loses focus during the movement and recovers naturally.

No exaggerated athletic movement.

00:14–00:19 — LOCAL SHOP
He walks to a tiny neighborhood shop and buys a cold drink.
He exchanges a few natural words with the shopkeeper but the conversation is not clearly audible.
He steps outside, opens the bottle, takes a drink, and leans casually against the wall.
He watches bicycles and pedestrians passing in the distance.
The camera remains handheld and slightly imperfect.

00:19–00:23 — SUMMER RAIN
A sudden summer shower begins.
He looks toward the sky with mild surprise.
Instead of immediately running for shelter, he smiles and slowly walks into the rain.
The rain becomes heavier.
His hair becomes wet and falls naturally across his forehead.
He eventually starts running down the alley, laughing genuinely.
He briefly spins around while running, then continues toward a covered walkway.
His clothes become visibly damp.
Maintain realistic rain interaction, wet fabric, wet hair, reflections, and foot contact with the ground.

00:23–00:27 — QUIET MOMENT
He reaches the covered walkway and catches his breath.
Rain falls heavily behind him.
He wipes water from his forehead and looks quietly toward the street.
For a moment, everything becomes still.
He notices the camera again.
He gives a small genuine smile, not a posed expression.

00:27–00:30 — WALKING AWAY
The rain becomes lighter.
He walks away down the wet residential lane.
The camera follows from behind.
Reflections shimmer across the concrete.
He turns his head once, gives a tiny wave toward the camera, smiles, and continues walking.
The camera remains pointed toward the empty street for a brief moment.
At approximately 00:29, the recording abruptly cuts to black mid-motion.
No fade-out.

PHYSICAL REALISM
Maintain believable real-world physics throughout.
Hands, fingers, feet, clothing, hair, rain, bottle, basketball, and background objects must behave naturally.

No extra fingers, fused hands, duplicated limbs, distorted anatomy, floating objects, teleportation, disappearing objects, or sudden transformations.
The bottle remains a separate physical object and never intersects with his face.

The basketball behaves naturally and remains where it lands.

Parked bicycles and background objects remain stationary unless physically moved.

His feet remain properly connected to the ground while walking and running.

Keep the environment and subject consistent between shots.

AUDIO
Natural environmental audio only.
Footsteps on concrete, distant traffic, birds, leaves moving in the wind, bicycles, faint neighborhood conversations, shop sounds, bottle opening, basketball bouncing, rain hitting concrete, water dripping from rooftops, and subtle camera-handling noise.
No music.
No narration.
No soundtrack.
No artificial sound effects.
No spoken dialogue is necessary.
FINAL FEEL
The result should feel like a forgotten personal recording of an ordinary summer day.
Not a commercial.
Not a fashion film.
Not a music video.
Not a professional cinematic production.
The emotional appeal should come from small human moments: sitting alone, wandering through familiar streets, missing a basketball shot, drinking something cold, getting caught in the rain, laughing, and walking home.

Quiet, masculine, youthful, nostalgic, slightly melancholic, warm, spontaneous, and deeply human.
Prioritize natural behavior, consistent identity, believable physics, imperfect handheld framing, authentic environmental details, and the feeling that the camera happened to be there.

entries.prompt:

A cinematic travel montage of a solitary young female hiker exploring vast dramatic natural landscapes. Shot-by-shot timeline (exact pacing & camera language)

0.0–1.8s  
Wide static-to-slow push-in. Woman sitting on mossy green highland plateau, back to camera, hands resting on the grass, white beanie, sage jacket, dark backpack. Vast turquoise lake dotted with small rounded islands under heavy layered cloudy sky with soft blue openings. Soft overcast daylight, cool teal-green color grade. Gentle breeze moves her hair. Camera slowly creeps forward and slightly rises, emphasizing solitude and scale.

1.8–3.1s  
Tracking shot from behind at medium-wide. She walks steadily uphill across rolling emerald hills, trekking pole in right hand, white beanie, same backpack. A vivid double rainbow arcs across the grey-green sky over distant soft mountains. Slight handheld micro-sway, camera following at her walking pace, low and slightly behind.

3.1–4.2s
Static wide shot. She stands alone on a small grassy spit at the edge of a dark alpine lake, facing away, white hoodie, yellow-tinged beanie. Towering jagged black peaks rise steeply, low white clouds and mist clinging to the rock faces. Moody, desaturated blue-grey light. Still water reflects the mountains. Pure contemplative silence.

4.2–5.9s  
Slow aerial drone pull-back and slight orbit. High-angle reveal of the same dark lake from above — perfect circular dark water, dense conifer forest, tiny red-roofed building at the shore, dramatic mist-shrouded granite spires and snow patches. Low clouds pour over the ridges like a waterfall. Cool high-contrast desaturated grade. Smooth floating drone motion.

5.9–7.8s  
Night sequence. Extreme wide. Black SUV with glowing red taillights drives slowly left-to-right on a flat dark lakeshore road. Massive violet-pink lightning bolt cracks across the deep indigo sky, illuminating distant mountains and water for a fraction of a second. Camera holds wide and static. Residual thin lightning forks linger after the flash.

7.8–9s  
Golden-hour peak shot. Woman stands on a grassy ridgeline, white bucket hat, backpack, one trekking pole, looking left toward the horizon. Endless layered mountain ranges fade into soft atmospheric haze under glowing orange-pink sunrise/sunset. Soft rim light on her silhouette. Slow subtle push-in.

9–11.6s 
Epic aerial tracking shot. Smooth high-speed drone follows a black SUV driving along a winding dirt mountain road through lush green karst-like hills. Multiple white wind turbines on ridges. Deep valleys with patchwork green fields, distant lake and town. Brilliant clear blue sky with scattered white cumulus. Camera flies parallel and slightly above the road, car becomes a tiny moving element.

11.60–14s  
Intimate POV from inside a car (slightly soft foreground of A-pillar and side mirror). Through the open window we see the same woman standing outside on the overlook, white bucket hat, green backpack, holding binoculars to her eyes, gazing at the vast green mountain range and wind turbines under late-afternoon light. Soft focus on car interior, sharp on her and the landscape. Gentle breeze moves her hair.

Overall cinematography & technical notes
Camera language: locked-off contemplative wides, slow creeping push-ins, organic tracking, floating drone reveals, one intimate car-POV. Never shaky.  
Lighting progression: soft overcast → dramatic rainbow → cold misty alpine → night lightning → golden hour → crisp clear daylight.  
Color science: cool teal-greens and greys early, warm golden tones mid-way, rich emerald and deep blue later. Subtle anamorphic flare and gentle film grain.  
Mood: quiet awe, solitude, the scale of nature vs one small human traveler. 24 fps cinematic motion, 4K detail.

entries.description: 用寫實人物與霓虹舞台結合格鬥遊戲美學，提示詞要求 15 秒直式動作。
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second vertical 9:16 ultra-realistic cinematic action sequence set on a massive outdoor stage in a futuristic neon city, inspired by a high-budget fighting game.

A huge muscular male fighter with spiky golden hair, wearing loose white martial-arts pants, a red waist sash, golden wristbands and boots, stands confidently in the center of the stage while a massive crowd watches and records on their smartphones. Behind him is a dense modern city skyline filled with glowing billboards, neon signs, skyscrapers, smoke, and dramatic evening lighting.

A blonde female fighter wearing a dark blue and red superhero-style combat suit suddenly attacks him at high speed. She leaps through the air and delivers a powerful spinning kick toward the male fighter. He remains composed, then counters with an explosive martial-arts strike, sending her flying backward across the stage.

Show dynamic hand-to-hand combat with realistic body mechanics, powerful impacts, flying dust and smoke, subtle camera shake, dramatic slow motion during the kick, and a fast cinematic camera push-in during the counterattack.

The crowd reacts with excitement, raising their phones and cheering. Capture the atmosphere of a live street-fighting spectacle with hundreds of spectators in the foreground.

Visual style: photorealistic AAA video-game cinematic, highly detailed characters, realistic skin and fabric textures, physically accurate lighting, volumetric smoke, neon reflections, cinematic depth of field, realistic motion blur, dramatic contrast, dynamic camera movement, epic action choreography.

Camera: vertical handheld smartphone-style perspective mixed with cinematic tracking shots, low-angle hero shots, rapid push-ins, slight camera shake during impacts, smooth slow motion at key moments.

End with the female fighter being thrown into the air as smoke and dust fill the stage, while the muscular fighter stands triumphantly in the center and the crowd erupts behind him.

No dialogue, no subtitles, no text overlays, no logos, no watermark. Maintain consistent character appearance throughout the entire sequence.

entries.title: 夕陽鳥居下的最後一戰
entries.description: 15 秒 16:9 武士戰把夕陽、實景材質與動作接觸一起寫，保持真人電影感。
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second live-action cinematic samurai battle, 16:9, ultra-realistic movie quality, practical-looking effects, natural human movement, detailed costumes, realistic physics, and dramatic handheld camera work. Avoid an obvious AI or cartoon appearance.

Story: After protecting a sacred village, a wounded white-haired samurai returns to an ancient torii gate at sunset—only to find the demon warrior who destroyed his clan waiting for him. This is their final confrontation.

0–3s: Wide establishing shot. A ruined Japanese shrine and massive torii gate stand beneath a blood-red sunset. Dust blows across the ground. The samurai slowly walks forward, gripping his black katana. Across from him, a huge dark armored demon waits silently, red eyes glowing through the smoke.

3–6s: The demon suddenly charges. The samurai blocks a devastating strike. Their swords collide repeatedly—fast, heavy, and physical. Sparks burst from every impact as they move through the ruined shrine.

6–11s: The fight becomes relentless. Close-range sword exchanges, brutal parries, spinning attacks, dodges, low slides, and powerful counterattacks. The demon smashes through wooden structures while the samurai narrowly escapes. Camera rapidly follows them with realistic motion blur, impact shakes, flying dust, sparks, and debris. The samurai finally finds an opening.

11–13s: In one explosive final exchange, both warriors sprint toward each other. Their blades cross in slow motion. The samurai lands a precise finishing cut and stops behind the demon.

13–15s: Silence. The demon collapses into drifting black ash. The samurai lowers his sword and looks toward the enormous setting sun. Wind moves his torn haori as the last embers disappear into the sky.

Visual style: Photorealistic live-action Japanese period film, grounded martial-arts choreography, realistic sword physics, practical-looking smoke and sparks, natural skin and fabric texture, cinematic lighting, deep shadows, anamorphic lens feel, subtle film grain, realistic camera movement, dramatic pacing, believable weight and impact.

Character consistency: One white-haired wounded samurai in a torn white haori and one towering black-armored demon with glowing red eyes. No extra characters, no duplicates, no subtitles, no text, no watermark, no cartoon look, no exaggerated CGI, no artificial-looking movement.

entries.title: 酒紅真絲高定時裝大片
entries.description: 以人物參考和真實布料反光支撐高定廣告，將服裝質感與光線明確拆出來。
entries.prompt:
【风格】顶级奢侈品牌大片（Ultra-Luxury Fashion Haute Couture Film），Vogue国际时尚大片质感，电影级摄影（Photorealistic），8K超清画质，16:9宽画幅，阿莱电影机调色（ARRI Alexa Color Science），光影粒子（Cinematic Dust & Flare），顶级柔焦布光
【时长】20秒
【比例】16:9
【场景】极简高级灰调水泥立柱影棚 ➔ 落地窗暮色光影露台，冷暖光影交织
【角色】时尚超模@图片2 穿着高定真丝礼服@图片1（五官立体冷艳、身姿修长的东方超模，身穿酒红色真丝挂脖睡裙，胸前为立体镂空蝴蝶纹理与流苏系带，后背为大面积极简露背设计，下摆为层叠不规则如波浪般垂坠的丝缎裙摆）

[00:00-00:03] 镜头1：宏观微距·丝缎流光（Macro Lens Extreme Close-Up）
【微距镜头/极慢平移（Macro Pan）】16:9 极简构图。
画面细节：微距特写酒红色的高品质真丝面料，光线以45度角扫过，面料如同流动的红酒与液体黄金，折射出深邃奢华的缎面微光。
细节动作：模特修长精致的手指轻轻拂过丝缎边缘，织物随着指尖滑过产生丝滑细腻的物理波纹。
【转场】：镜头迅速虚化光斑切换（Focus Blur Transition）

[00:03-00:06] 镜头2：高定锁骨·系带流苏（Close-Up on Collarbone & Detail）
【近景特写/斜角侧光（Chiaroscuro Lighting）】
焦点与细节：焦点对准模特修长的天鹅颈与精致锁骨。
设计亮点：极近特写胸前精致的镂空立体蝴蝶纹理与胸口中央悬垂的流苏系带；细窄的酒红挂脖细绳从颈后绕过，流苏随微风轻轻晃动，极具法式优雅与高级呼吸感。
【转场】：镜头顺势向后拉开（Dolly Out）

[00:06-00:10] 镜头3：绝美露背·侧身回眸（Medium Orbit Shot / The Backless Silhouette）
【中景180度半环绕运镜（Orbit Tracking）】
构图与光影：模特背对镜头，落地窗外的暮色暖阳勾勒出背部绝美的肩胛骨线条与大面积露背剪裁，酒红真丝与冷白肌肤形成极高级的视觉对比。
动作：模特迈着轻盈从容的步伐向前，随后以优雅的慢动作（Slow-mo Turn）缓缓侧身回眸，眼神清冷高级、带着顶级超模的从容与睥睨。
【转场】：镜头掠过光晕（Lens Flare Cut）

[00:10-00:14] 镜头4：曼妙旋转·裙摆绽放（Slow-Motion Spin & Fabric Physics）
【中全景仰拍/极致升格慢动作（Super Slow-mo）】
动作与动态物理：模特在影棚中央轻盈旋转半圈，层叠不规则的酒红色真丝裙摆瞬间如盛开的深红玫瑰般在半空中完全舒展、波浪状翻滚荡漾（Hyper-realistic Silk Fluid Simulation）。
视觉效果：真丝裙摆在空中滞空翻飞，光影在流动褶皱中变幻，尽显衣服的轻盈与极致垂坠感。
【转场】：快速推近切入正前方（Quick Push-In）

[00:14-00:17] 镜头5：气场全开·台步迈进（Full Body Runway Stride）
【全身大景深低角度跟拍（Low-Angle Steadicam Tracking）】
构图与气场：16:9 横向大画幅，空间留白高级。
动作：模特气场全开，迈着稳健从容的顶级超模台步自光影深处迎面走向镜头，酒红丝缎裙摆随着迈步节奏在双腿间律动生风，身姿修长挺拔，极具大牌成衣发布会的压迫感与奢华气场。
【转场】：平滑推向面部与半身（Smooth Dolly In）

[00:17-00:20] 镜头6：神颜收束·奢华定格（Hero Close-Up & Final Brand Frame）
【中近景特写定格（Hero Shot）】
微表情与终章：模特在镜头前站定，身姿微侧，单手优雅插腰。
神态细节：她微微昂首，红唇微启，眼神在镜头前流露出自信、松弛而神秘的顶级超模神韵；一缕发丝随风飘过脸庞，酒红真丝裙摆缓缓归于沉静，画面在极具胶片质感的光影中完美定格。

entries.title: 霸總電影院偷牽手被大嬸教訓
entries.description: 30 秒直式先寫三排座位的左右關係，再安排偷牽手與反應，避免多人位置混亂。
entries.prompt:
30秒短劇，9:16，電影感，現代都市黑色喜劇風格，電影級光影。

場景：現代都市夜晚高級電影院內，昏暗燈光，大螢幕播放《白衣女鬼從電視爬出》的恐怖片。三排座位中間區域，空間邏輯清晰：霸總坐左側、女秘書坐右側（兩人中間扶手）、女秘書更右側是正在大口吃爆米花的中年胖大嬸。銀幕藍白冷光與座椅暖黃微光對比，氛圍從恐怖逐漸轉為曖昧，最後徹底搞笑崩壞。

角色：
英俊蓄鬍霸總<<<Image1>>>  ：35歲，英俊成熟，短髮蓄鬍、精緻五官、氣場強大，穿淺灰色合身西裝，眼神色瞇瞇又帶玩味。
女秘書<<<Image2>>>  ：25歲，清純美麗、長黑直髮、精緻五官，穿簡約職業套裝（白襯衫+黑窄裙），氣質專業卻容易害羞緊張。
中年胖大嬸<<<Image3>>>  ：50歲左右，俗氣的及肩捲髮，臉頰上明顯雀斑，誇張的藍色眼影，整形過度的浮腫鮮豔雙唇，圓潤體型、穿廉價平底鞋與寬鬆花色衣服，表情先是專心看電影，後轉為忍無可忍的正義感。

風格：電影級寫實光影，冷藍銀幕光與暖黃座椅燈對比，柔焦側臉與突兀喜劇節奏，整體從恐怖張力→曖昧輕挑→爆笑崩壞。

分鏡（0-30秒）：
0-3s：大螢幕特寫白衣女鬼從老舊電視爬出，陰森音樂響起，全場觀眾屏息。女秘書坐在右側座位，眉毛深鎖、眼睛緊盯銀幕，專注又害怕。
3-5s：霸總坐在她左側，色瞇瞇地側頭望著女秘書美麗側臉，嘴角微揚，偷偷將手伸過去，握住她擱在兩人之間扶手上的左手。
5-7s：女秘書被嚇到，身體微顫，下意識想抽回左手，卻被霸總輕輕扣住。
7-10s：霸總湊近她耳邊，用低沉曖昧的聲音輕聲挑逗（中文）：「害怕的話……就靠過來一點啊。」同時用拇指輕撫她手背，另一手悄悄搭上她肩膀。
10-13s：女秘書臉頰微紅、呼吸急促，又羞又慌地想推開，霸總卻越靠越近，準備吻她。
13-15s：右側中年胖大嬸終於忍無可忍，怒目圓睜，把手中整桶爆米花「嘩」地全部撒在霸總頭上。
15-17s：女秘書嚇得尖叫，急忙拍掉自己身上與頭髮上的爆米花，表情又驚又窘。
17-20s：中年胖大嬸的廉價平底鞋踩到地上散落的爆米花，重心瞬間不穩，整個人往前撲倒，直接摔進霸總懷裡。
20-23s：霸總愣了一秒，隨即雙手抱住胖大嬸，深情又熱情地吻了上去（臉貼臉深吻）。
23-26s：女秘書氣得滿臉通紅，猛地起身轉身離去，高跟鞋踩得響亮。
26-30s：現場其他觀眾哄堂大笑，連大螢幕上的白衣女鬼也突然轉頭看向鏡頭，跟著張大嘴巴大笑，畫面fade into black。

entries.title: 創作者被吸進開放世界遊戲
entries.description: 15 秒 UGC 短片將真實人物與遊戲世界轉換連起來，保留手機拍攝的自然感。
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic UGC-style video where a young female creator suddenly finds herself physically inside a fictional open-world video game. She is a real, live-action human character interacting naturally with the game's world, not a gamer watching a screen.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:
The exact same young female creator throughout the entire video. Clear realistic face, natural skin texture, expressive eyes, stylish Gen-Z streetwear, same hairstyle and outfit in every shot. She must look like a real person seamlessly placed inside the game world.

0–3 SEC — ENTERING THE GAME

Start with the creator standing in a realistic bedroom holding a game controller. The screen suddenly glitches with a dramatic digital distortion. In a seamless transition, the environment around her transforms and she is teleported directly into a huge fictional open-world city.

She looks around in shock and says:
“Wait… I’m actually inside the game?!”

3–7 SEC — OPEN-WORLD CHAOS

She is now physically walking through the game's city streets as a live character. Massive skyscrapers, pedestrians, sports cars, traffic lights, shops and cinematic city details surround her.

She looks at her hands, then touches a nearby car and reacts with genuine disbelief.

A police siren suddenly starts in the distance.

7–11 SEC — THE CHASE

She jumps into a fictional sports car and starts driving through the city.

Camera switches between third-person cinematic game-camera shots and close-up live-action shots of her face inside the vehicle.

Police cars begin chasing her. She laughs nervously and says:

“Oh no… I think I’m wanted!”

11–15 SEC — ESCAPE

She dramatically turns into a narrow alley, narrowly avoids a pursuing police vehicle, and escapes into an underground parking garage.

She stops the car, looks directly into the camera and says:

“Okay… how do I get OUT?!”

End with a dramatic cinematic pull-back revealing the enormous fictional game city around her.

VISUAL STYLE

Ultra-realistic live-action human seamlessly integrated into a photorealistic open-world game environment, cinematic game graphics, realistic physics, natural facial expressions, detailed city, dynamic camera movement, realistic vehicles, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, high-end VFX, premium gaming trailer + authentic UGC reaction style.

IMPORTANT: The woman must remain a realistic live human character inside the game world. Do not make her look like a cartoon, CGI avatar, animated character, or video-game model.

Create an original fictional open-world crime-action game aesthetic. Do not use GTA logos, characters, locations, UI, music, copyrighted assets, or recognizable game elements.

No text overlays, subtitles, watermarks, logos, or futuristic objects.

entries.description: 30 秒產品片先定義虛構品牌與瓶身，再安排使用情境及產品鏡頭。
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic cinematic product commercial for fictional premium smart water bottle LUMEN. The bottle should be the hero product while the woman remains visible and naturally interacts with it throughout the film.

Character consistency: Same stylish young woman, early 20s, long dark hair, natural makeup and identical facial features throughout. Keep the exact LUMEN bottle design, color and proportions consistent.

Scene 1 — City Morning
The woman walks through the city wearing a fitted white athletic top, high-waisted beige trousers, white sneakers and a lightweight cream jacket, carrying the LUMEN bottle. Show her full body, then a brief close-up of the bottle and hydration indicator.

Scene 2 — Park Workout
She arrives at a park wearing a black fitted sports top, black high-waisted leggings and white running shoes. After jogging, she takes a refreshing sip from LUMEN. Show condensation, water movement and the bottle’s premium materials.

Scene 3 — Café
She sits at a modern café wearing a soft beige knit sweater, straight-leg blue jeans and white sneakers, with LUMEN beside her. She picks it up and drinks while working on her laptop.

Scene 4 — Visual Transformation
As she takes another sip, transition into cinematic visuals of crystal-clear mountain water, flowing streams and ocean waves, then seamlessly return to the bottle in her hand. Keep her outfit consistent with the café scene.

Scene 5 — Sunset Hero Shot
She stands on a rooftop wearing a sleek black blazer, fitted white top, tailored trousers and elegant sneakers, holding LUMEN while watching the sunset. Camera slowly pushes toward the bottle, capturing reflections, condensation and the illuminated hydration indicator.

Voiceover:
“Your day moves fast. Your hydration should keep up. LUMEN keeps every sip within reach and reminds you when it matters. Stay refreshed. Stay moving.”

Style: Photorealistic luxury product cinematography, realistic skin and fabrics, cinematic lighting, macro product details, natural movement, shallow depth of field, realistic reflections, smooth transitions and premium commercial quality.

Negative: No bottle morphing, design changes, identity drift, distorted hands, extra fingers, random outfits, duplicated people, floating objects, excessive CGI, subtitles, captions, random text or watermark.

entries.title: 無線耳機 UGC 廣告
entries.description: 20 秒直式以身份鎖定段保留臉型、髮際線與服裝，再拍自然的產品互動。
entries.prompt:
Create a 20-second ultra-realistic cinematic UGC advertisement, vertical 9:16, featuring the EXACT SAME male character from Reference Image 1. Strictly preserve his facial identity, face structure, skin tone, hairstyle, hairline, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, beard/stubble and overall appearance. No identity drift, face morphing, aging or redesign.

PRODUCT: premium modern wireless earbuds with sleek minimalist matte-black charging case, subtle metallic details, realistic luxury-tech appearance, no recognizable brand/logo.

WARDROBE: fitted black premium T-shirt, minimalist dark overshirt/jacket, black watch, subtle accessories, sophisticated urban look.

SETTING: modern luxury apartment/stylish urban workspace during golden hour, warm window light, realistic shadows, tasteful furniture and subtle city ambience. Premium lifestyle + authentic UGC + cinematic commercial aesthetic.

0–4s: Close-up of male looking slightly tired after a busy day. He picks up the earbud case from a table, camera quickly pushes toward product. He looks at camera confidently: “These changed my daily routine.”

4–8s: Cinematic macro reveal as he opens the case, removes an earbud and puts it in. Smooth product movement and shallow depth of field. Dialogue: “The sound is seriously impressive.”

8–13s: Male walks through apartment and works at desk wearing earbuds. Show natural tap interaction, earbud close-up, working shots and product case. Dialogue: “Music, calls, work… everything feels better.”

13–17s: Male stands by window in golden-hour light, looks directly into camera and holds case toward lens. Dialogue: “Honestly, I keep them with me everywhere.”

17–20s: Hero product shot: earbuds and case sharply focused in foreground, male softly blurred behind. Slow cinematic movement and premium reflections. On-screen text: “Sound. Style. Freedom.” then “Upgrade Your Everyday.”

AUDIO: original modern premium lifestyle beat with smooth electronic bass, atmospheric synth and subtle percussion; minimal at start, gradually builds, slight impact on final reveal. No copyrighted music. Dialogue remains crisp.

entries.description: 以虛構電動滑板車的品牌片結構，連接產品展示與實際騎行場景。
entries.prompt:
Create a ultra-realistic cinematic brand commercial for a fictional premium electric scooter brand called VOLTIS. The film follows a young woman moving through a modern city, showing how VOLTIS turns an ordinary commute into an effortless urban adventure.
Character: Same young woman throughout, long dark hair, natural makeup, confident and energetic personality.
Scooter: Premium matte-black electric scooter with subtle metallic details, integrated LED headlight, digital display, wide deck, sleek aerodynamic frame and clearly visible VOLTIS branding. Keep the exact scooter design, logo, proportions and details consistent throughout.
Scene 1 — The Start | 0–5s
Early morning. The woman leaves a modern apartment wearing a cream fitted jacket, white top, straight-leg black trousers and white sneakers. She unlocks the VOLTIS scooter and checks the digital display.
Close-up of the VOLTIS logo, handlebar controls and LED display.
VO:
“Somewhere between here and there… there’s a better way to move.”
Scene 2 — City Commute | 5–10s
She rides through a clean modern city street wearing the same outfit. Use smooth tracking shots, front and side angles and a few wide shots showing the entire city around her.
She effortlessly moves through the morning commute while cars remain stuck in traffic.
Show the scooter's smooth acceleration and responsive handling.
Scene 3 — Different Terrain | 10–15s
Transition to a city park and smooth pedestrian cycling path. She wears a lightweight sage-green windbreaker, black athletic leggings and the same white sneakers.
She rides through the park, passes trees and open spaces, then takes a gentle uphill path.
Show close-ups of the wheels, suspension and deck moving naturally over the pavement.
VO:
“Smooth when the city moves fast. Steady when the road changes.”
Scene 4 — Unexpected Rain | 15–20s
Clouds gather and rain begins.
She now wears a black waterproof jacket, black leggings and the same sneakers. She continues riding carefully along wet urban streets.
Show realistic rain droplets, wet pavement reflections, water splashes from the tires and the LED headlight illuminating the road.
VO:
“Because your journey doesn’t always go according to plan.”
Scene 5 — Sunset Freedom | 20–26s
Golden hour. She rides along a scenic riverside road wearing a beige oversized jacket, white top, relaxed dark trousers and white sneakers.
The city glows behind her. Use a wide cinematic tracking shot followed by a low-angle shot of the scooter moving smoothly along the road.
She smiles naturally as she rides.
Scene 6 — Final Hero Shot | 26–30s
She stops at a beautiful city overlook at sunset and steps off the scooter.
She looks toward the skyline while standing beside VOLTIS.
Slow camera push-in toward the scooter. The VOLTIS logo and sleek silhouette are clearly visible.
VO:
“VOLTIS. Take the shortcut.”
End on a clean premium brand frame featuring the scooter and VOLTIS logo.
Visual Style
Premium global mobility campaign, photorealistic live-action aesthetic, cinematic city cinematography, realistic riding physics, natural human movement, dynamic tracking shots, realistic reflections, subtle motion blur, golden-hour lighting, detailed materials, authentic urban environments and sophisticated commercial pacing.
Safety: Show the rider wearing a properly fitted helmet whenever riding, with controlled riding in appropriate areas and no dangerous traffic maneuvers.
Negative prompt: scooter design changes, misspelled VOLTIS logo, logo distortion, unrealistic riding physics, floating wheels, distorted hands, extra limbs, dangerous traffic behavior, excessive CGI, identity drift, inconsistent outfits within scenes, duplicated people, random text, subtitles, watermark.

entries.description: 30 秒 Vlog 用手持拍攝、真實膚質與環境細節降低過度完美的攝影感。
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic professional vlog video, filmed like authentic footage from a real travel/content creator visiting a modern wildlife zoo. 16:9 horizontal, 4K, natural daylight, realistic skin texture, real-world physics, authentic animal behavior, natural camera movement, realistic environmental audio, professional documentary/vlogging quality.

The entire video must feel 100% real and naturally filmed, not CGI, not animation, not a cinematic fantasy scene, and not AI-generated. Avoid overly perfect lighting, plastic-looking skin, unnatural animal movements, fake-looking backgrounds, excessive sharpness, or impossible camera movements.

MAIN VLOGGER:
A young adult woman in casual modern clothes, natural makeup, realistic hair movement, carrying a small vlog camera. Keep her face, hairstyle, clothing and appearance perfectly consistent throughout all shots.

0–5 SEC — HOOK

Start with a handheld selfie shot as the girl walks through the zoo entrance.

She looks directly into the camera with genuine excitement.

Girl:
“Okay, I just got inside the zoo… and apparently, the lions are this way!”

Natural footsteps, distant visitors, birds and subtle zoo ambience in the background.

Quick natural camera movement as she turns the camera toward the animal section.

5–10 SEC — WALKING THROUGH THE ZOO

Cut naturally to a walking shot following her from slightly behind.

She walks along a realistic zoo pathway surrounded by trees, signs, families and visitors.

She occasionally looks toward animal enclosures.

Girl:
“I honestly didn’t expect it to be this busy today.”

Her voice should sound spontaneous and conversational, with natural pauses and breathing.

10–16 SEC — LION ENCLOSURE

She reaches a realistic lion enclosure.

Switch to a handheld over-the-shoulder shot showing her watching a real-looking adult lion resting naturally on a large rock.

The lion moves naturally, blinks, breathes, looks around and briefly raises its head.

No exaggerated animal behavior.

Girl, quietly:
“Oh wow… look at him. He’s literally just chilling.”

Natural zoo ambience continues.

16–22 SEC — ELEPHANT AREA

Smooth but realistic handheld transition to the elephant enclosure.

A large elephant naturally walks toward a water area, uses its trunk to drink and gently moves its ears.

The girl appears beside the enclosure, keeping a safe distance.

Girl:
“And the elephants are even bigger than I imagined.”

She laughs naturally.

22–27 SEC — CLOSE VLOG MOMENT

Return to a selfie shot.

The girl walks slowly while talking directly to the camera.

Sunlight naturally filters through the trees.

Girl:
“I think this might already be my favorite part of the day.”

She briefly turns the camera toward the animals behind her.

27–30 SEC — NATURAL ENDING

End with a spontaneous shot of the girl smiling while walking away from the camera.

She turns back toward the lens.

Girl:
“Anyway, I’m going to explore the rest of the zoo. Come with me!”

She laughs slightly and continues walking.

REALISM & PRODUCTION REQUIREMENTS

- Photorealistic live-action appearance
- Authentic zoo environment
- Realistic human skin, hair and facial expressions
- Natural animal anatomy and behavior
- Realistic animal fur and skin textures
- Natural daylight and shadows
- Realistic reflections and materials
- Handheld vlog camera movement with subtle stabilization
- Occasional natural autofocus adjustment
- Realistic exposure changes when moving between bright and shaded areas
- Authentic background visitors behaving naturally
- Natural ambient zoo sounds
- Girl's voice recorded like a real vlog microphone
- Accurate lip synchronization
- Natural blinking, breathing and body movement
- No exaggerated cinematic effects
- No fantasy elements
- No artificial-looking animals
- No distorted faces or hands
- No duplicated people

entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic fight scene, shot like a high-budget action movie. The scene takes place at night in a narrow urban street after light rain. The wet asphalt reflects streetlights and neon signs, creating realistic cinematic reflections. Two adult male fighters face each other, both wearing slightly dirty, realistic everyday clothing.

0–3 seconds: Start with a wide establishing shot. Both fighters stand several feet apart, breathing heavily and staring at each other with intense expressions. Light rain falls around them. The camera slowly pushes forward with subtle handheld movement. Realistic ambient city sounds, distant traffic, footsteps, rain and heavy breathing.

3–6 seconds: One fighter suddenly moves forward and throws a realistic punch. The other fighter quickly blocks and steps backward. Use natural body mechanics, realistic weight, believable footwork and authentic reactions. Camera switches to a dynamic medium tracking shot, following the movement.

6–10 seconds: The second fighter counters with two fast punches. The first fighter dodges the first punch and blocks the second. Show realistic impact reactions without exaggerated superhero movements. Clothing and hair react naturally to the motion. Use a brief slow-motion moment during the dodge, then immediately return to real-time speed.

10–13 seconds: The fighters exchange a short sequence of close-range defensive movements and strikes. Keep the choreography grounded and realistic, with natural balance, fatigue and imperfect movements. Camera moves around them in a smooth handheld cinematic arc.

13–15 seconds: One fighter lands a strong final body-level strike, causing the other fighter to stumble backward and fall against a wall. End with a close-up of the standing fighter breathing heavily while rain continues falling. The camera slowly pulls back as the street lights flicker in the background.

Visual style: photorealistic, cinematic movie quality, realistic human anatomy, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions, physically accurate movement, detailed wet clothing, realistic rain droplets, atmospheric night lighting, subtle lens flare, shallow depth of field, natural motion blur, realistic shadows, high dynamic range, cinematic contrast, 35mm film look, professional action cinematography.

Camera: realistic handheld camera, smooth tracking shots, wide establishing shot, medium action shots, close-up reaction shots, natural camera shake during impacts, realistic focus pulls, cinematic depth of field.

Lighting: practical streetlights, soft neon reflections on wet pavement, realistic rim lighting, subtle volumetric atmosphere, natural shadows, no artificial glowing effects.

Audio: realistic rain, footsteps on wet asphalt, breathing, clothing movement, distant traffic, realistic impact sounds, subtle cinematic background score that builds tension.

Important: Make the entire sequence feel like real footage captured by a professional film crew, not animation or a video game. No superhero physics, no exaggerated punches, no impossible movements, no cartoon effects, no excessive camera shake, no distorted faces, no extra fingers or limbs, consistent characters throughout the entire 15 seconds.
