entries.title: 修圖工具闖進真實街頭的追逐喜劇
entries.description: 把光標與選框當有透視、投影和遮擋的實物，另用光源與空間軸線維持寫實追逐。
entries.prompt:
Duration：30秒

Aspect ratio：16:9横屏

Overall style：电影实拍质感的都市白天喜剧。真人演员，真实街道，手持跟拍的能量感。图像编辑软件的工具和界面元素以实物形态出现在真实街道上，包括光标、虚线选框、变换框、白色方形把手和灰白透明格子，它们有透视、有遮挡，地面上有淡淡的投影。所有编辑都瞬间完成，干净利落，滑稽无害。动作物理动量连续，严禁静止发呆，严禁塑料CG感。

SUBJECT / 角色与道具绑定：

图片1 命名为【Iaro】，容貌、发型、服装、配饰全部以参考图为准，全片保持一致；

（@只在此处声明一次，正文严禁再出现@）

道具【光标】：巨型电脑光标，带细黑描边的白色哑光实物，常态高约1.2米，悬浮在离地1到1.8米之间，地面上有淡灰色投影。光标有三种形态，切换时"啪"地瞬间变形：

- 箭头形态：经典左上指向的白色箭头；

- 油漆桶形态：白色倾斜的小桶图标，桶口朝下；

- 橡皮擦形态：白色长方体橡皮块，长约1米。

每次"点击"时，光标整体向前点约10厘米，伴随清脆的咔哒声。性格固执又狡猾。

路人与动物：

【遛狗姑娘】年轻女性，浅蓝色卫衣，手牵红色狗绳；

【小白】白色小型卷毛狗，常态肩高约25厘米，被放大后肩高约1.5米，性格欢快，见到会动的东西就想追。

ENVIRONMENT / 空间轴线：

现代城市商业街，晴朗白天。自然阳光从画面右上方45度照下，色温约5600K，阴影清晰柔和。人行道上有木质长椅、路边停着一辆白色厢式货车，有一面红砖墙，街角有一条两侧是砖墙、尽头被墙堵死的窄巷。追逐方向全片统一：Iaro始终从画面右侧往左侧逃，光标始终从画面右侧追来。所有招牌、车身、墙面上都没有任何文字、数字或Logo。

AUDIO / 声音位置，严格按时间（全片无台词，无人声）：

① 0.0s起：城市环境声（远处车流、鸟鸣、路人脚步），原创轻快放克配乐（贝斯加军鼓，无人声），低电平进入；

② 1.2s–2.4s：四声连续的"啵、啵、啵、啵"，冰淇淋球被复制出来；

③ 4.0s"咔哒"；5.6s第二声"咔哒"，长椅被复制，"咚"一声落地；6.2s四个冰淇淋球摔在地上，"啪嗒"；

④ 9.4s"咔哒"，接一声弹性拉伸的"啵——"；10.2s巨犬欢快地低沉吠叫"汪！"；

⑤ 13.2s油漆倾泻的"哗——"；16.2s橡皮摩擦的"擦擦擦"；

⑥ 19.0s光标放大，低频上扬"呜——"；20.0s巨犬吠叫，接着"嗷呜"一口，然后是撕咬玩具的"吱吱"声；

⑦ 23.5s甩水声"噗噜噜"；

⑧ 25.5s配乐戛然而止，只剩环境声；25.8s"咔哒"；26.0s爆炸头弹开，"嘭"的一声；26.8s拍头时头发的弹簧声"啵嘤"；

⑨ 28.0s–30.0s安静，光标晃动时两声俏皮的电子音"嘀嘀"，巨犬尾巴拍地"啪、啪、啪"。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SHOT 1（0.0s–3.5s）｜【冰淇淋复制】

Subject：Iaro，光标

Action：Iaro坐在木质长椅中间，右手握一支单球香草冰淇淋甜筒，正伸舌头要舔。0.6s，箭头光标从画面右侧滑入，停在冰淇淋上方30厘米处。1.0s，一个小号虚线选框框住冰淇淋球。1.2s起，"咔哒"四连击，每0.3秒在顶上复制出一个完全一样的冰淇淋球，摞成5个球、约40厘米高的冰淇淋塔，微微摇晃。2.6s，Iaro眼睛睁大，嘴张开，抬头看光标，咧嘴笑，对光标点了点头。

Environment：长椅背后是人行道和店铺，有零星路人走过。

Camera：35mm，平视中景，Iaro在画面左三分之一处，光标在右三分之一处。1.2s起镜头轻微上摇，跟住长高的冰淇淋塔。

Style：冰淇淋表面有真实的奶油质感和阳光高光，球与球接触处轻微压扁。

Performance：从准备舔，到发愣，再到惊喜，要一气呵成。

Constraints：禁止冰淇淋球悬空分离，每个球必须压在下一个上面。禁止光标碰到Iaro。

SHOT 2（3.5s–7.5s）｜【目标换成Iaro】

Subject：Iaro，光标

Action：3.5s，光标慢慢把箭头转向Iaro。4.0s"咔哒"，一个黑白虚线矩形选框"啪"地合拢，把坐着的Iaro连同身下的长椅一起框住，虚线沿边缘流动。4.3s，Iaro的笑容收住，眼睛往下瞟虚线，再瞟回光标。4.8s，Iaro保持右手举着冰淇淋塔不动，屁股贴着椅面向画面左侧一点点平移，左脚先落地，身体侧滑出选框。选框留在原地。5.6s第二声"咔哒"：选框里的长椅被复制，一张一模一样的长椅"咚"地出现在原长椅右边，紧挨着。5.8s，落地震动让冰淇淋塔剧烈摇晃。6.2s，上面4个球依次滑落，"啪嗒"砸在人行道上，只剩最底下1个。6.6s，Iaro低头看剩下的1个球，再抬头看光标，嘴角下拉。7.0s，Iaro转身向画面左侧起跑，右脚蹬地，身体前倾。

Environment：两张长椅紧挨着并排，掉落的冰淇淋在地上摊开。

Camera：35mm，平视中景，与SHOT 1同轴线。7.0s镜头向左甩，跟住起跑。

Style：选框虚线约3厘米粗，在人身上和长椅上投下极淡的虚线影子。

Performance：侧滑时动作慢而小心，像怕吵醒什么，和后面的爆发起跑形成反差。

Constraints：长椅复制必须在5.6s瞬间完成，不得渐变。Iaro的外观不得发生任何变化。

SHOT 3（7.5s–12.0s）｜【小白变巨犬】

Subject：Iaro，光标，遛狗姑娘，小白

Action：Iaro在人行道上全速向画面左侧冲刺，双臂大幅摆动，光标在Iaro右后方2米处追赶。8.4s，前方遛狗姑娘牵着小白迎面走来。8.8s，Iaro右脚起跳，双膝收起，从小白头顶跃过，左脚先落地，继续跑。9.0s，光标的选框套向Iaro，Iaro已经跳过去，选框落在小白身上。9.4s"咔哒"：小白身上出现带8个白色方形把手的变换框，四角的把手同时向外拉，小白在0.5秒内被等比放大到肩高1.5米，像一匹小马。狗绳仍握在遛狗姑娘手里，姑娘的手臂被一下拉到头顶。10.2s，巨犬欢快地"汪"一声，尾巴猛摇，脑袋跟着光标转来转去，眼睛死死盯着光标，前爪在地上跃跃欲试。11.0s，Iaro边跑边回头，看到巨犬，瞪大眼睛，又回头看第二眼。

Environment：路人纷纷后退给巨犬让出空间，巨犬的卷毛逐根清晰，在阳光下发亮。

Camera：24mm，横移跟拍，机位在Iaro右侧3米处，与Iaro同速向左平移，腰部高度，轻微手持颠簸。

Style：放大后的狗毛质感真实，脚掌接地有重量感。

Performance：巨犬全程开心，不凶，像看见一个大号玩具球。

Constraints：禁止狗变形或变丑，只能等比放大。禁止遛狗姑娘摔倒。禁止Iaro碰到小白。

SHOT 4（12.0s–15.0s）｜【油漆桶：货车染紫】

Subject：Iaro，光标

Action：12.0s，Iaro冲到一辆停在路边的白色厢式货车旁，后背和双手掌心紧贴车身侧面，憋住呼吸，屏息躲藏。12.6s，光标"啪"地变成油漆桶形态，悬停在货车车尾上方。13.0s"咔哒"，桶口点在车尾，鲜艳的亮紫色从点击处向车头方向扩散，像水波一样漫过白色车身，0.6秒内覆盖整辆车。13.3s，Iaro瞥见紫色从右侧涌来，在紫色到达后背前0.2秒，双手一推车身，向画面左侧弹开半米。13.8s，整辆货车变成纯亮紫色，Iaro站在旁边，低头看自己的双手，确认没被染色，长出一口气，继续跑。

Environment：紫色只停在车身漆面上，车窗、轮胎、车灯都保持原样。

Camera：35mm，平视中景，侧面拍货车和Iaro，货车占画面右三分之二，Iaro在画面左侧边缘。

Style：紫色漆面在阳光下有真实的车漆反光。

Performance：贴车躲藏时双眼圆睁，嘴唇紧抿。

Constraints：Iaro身上不得沾到任何紫色。禁止油漆液体溅出车身之外，变色只发生在车身表面。

SHOT 5（15.0s–18.0s）｜【橡皮擦：墙上擦出透明格子】

Subject：Iaro，光标

Action：Iaro沿红砖墙向画面左侧奔跑。15.5s，光标"啪"地变成橡皮擦形态，从Iaro右后方追上来，在头部高度从右向左横扫过来。15.9s，Iaro双膝一弯，上身前折，向下滑铲，橡皮擦从Iaro头顶上方擦过，扫在砖墙上。16.2s，"擦擦擦"三下来回摩擦，砖墙被擦掉一块约1米见方的区域。缺口里不是墙洞，而是一块平整的灰白相间的棋盘格透明背景图案，边缘干净。16.8s，Iaro从滑铲中站起，停下回头，把脸凑近那块棋盘格，用右手食指轻戳一下，指尖碰到的是一个平面，Iaro的眉毛挑起。17.4s，橡皮擦又扫过来，Iaro转身拔腿就跑。

Environment：棋盘格每格约5厘米，灰白两色，平铺在墙面上，周围砖块完好。

Camera：35mm，跟拍转为静止中景。16.8s镜头轻推，Iaro的侧脸和棋盘格同时在画面里。

Style：棋盘格像墙面的一部分，同样被阳光照亮，有砖墙一致的透视。

Performance：戳棋盘格时的好奇和怀疑，是这段的笑点。

Constraints：禁止橡皮擦碰到Iaro。棋盘格禁止发光，禁止出现文字或数字。

SHOT 6（18.0s–22.5s）｜【死胡同：巨犬救场】

Subject：Iaro，光标，小白

Action：18.0s，Iaro拐进窄巷，跑到尽头，被墙堵住，转身背贴墙面，双手摊在墙上。18.5s，光标变回箭头形态，飘到巷口，周身出现变换框，从1.2米膨胀到3米高，堵住整个巷口。19.4s，光标拖出一个虚线矩形选框，框住整条巷子和Iaro。Iaro闭上眼，脸扭向一边。20.0s，巨犬从光标身后的巷口跃起，前爪腾空，一口咬住光标的尾端，叼在嘴里，落地后左右猛甩脑袋，像甩玩具一样。光标的变换框和选框同时闪两下消失，光标在狗嘴里缩回1.2米，被甩得左右乱晃。21.0s，巨犬叼着光标趴下，前爪按住，开心地啃咬，尾巴拍地。21.5s，Iaro睁开一只眼，再睁开另一只，背贴着墙慢慢滑坐到地上，喘着气笑出来。

Environment：窄巷两侧是红砖墙，地面有一些积水，巨犬落地时溅起水花。

Camera：18.0s–19.4s，24mm低机位，从Iaro身后、贴近墙角处拍出去，光标在巷口逆光。20.0s切35mm侧面中景，拍巨犬跃起叼住光标的完整动作弧线。

Style：光标在狗嘴里被咬出真实的压痕，有弹性。

Performance：巨犬全程是玩耍，不是攻击。

Constraints：禁止狗撕碎光标。禁止Iaro在本镜头被选中编辑。禁止出现文字。

SHOT 7（22.5s–25.5s）｜【以为结束了】

Subject：Iaro，光标，小白

Action：22.5s，Iaro站起来，拍了拍裤子，走到巨犬面前，伸手挠它的下巴，脸上是得意的笑。23.0s，巨犬张嘴吐舌头哈气，光标从嘴里滑出，湿漉漉、皱巴巴地掉在地上。23.5s，光标晃晃悠悠浮起，飘到Iaro后脑后方1米处，像狗一样抖身，"噗噜噜"甩出一圈水珠，皱褶瞬间恢复平整。Iaro背对着光标，正在摸狗，毫无察觉。

Environment：甩出的水珠在阳光下闪亮，落在地上。

Camera：35mm，平视中景，Iaro和巨犬在画面左侧，光标在画面右侧Iaro的身后升起，镜头静止。

Style：浅景深，Iaro和光标都清晰。

Performance：Iaro完全放松，甚至有点得意，和下一镜形成反差。

Constraints：Iaro不得回头。光标抖水时不得碰到Iaro。

SHOT 8（25.5s–28.0s）｜【红色爆炸头】

Subject：Iaro，光标

Action：25.8s"咔哒"，一个虚线矩形选框"啪"地合拢，只框住Iaro的头部。26.0s，无论Iaro原本是什么发型，都在0.4秒内"嘭"地膨胀成一个巨大的鲜红色爆炸头：直径约60厘米，正圆形，由紧密的小卷组成，整颗都是同一种正红色，比Iaro的肩膀还宽。26.4s，选框消失。26.6s，Iaro整个人僵住，手还停在狗下巴上。Iaro的右手慢慢抬起来，拍了一下头顶，爆炸头像弹簧一样上下弹了两下。

Environment：爆炸头的边缘在阳光下透出红色的光晕。

Camera：35mm，从Iaro侧后方的中景开始，26.0s起缓慢推近，让爆炸头的体积和形状一目了然。

Style：发卷逐根清晰，有真实的蓬松度和弹性，绝不能是一块头套或一颗毛球。

Performance：从僵住到拍头，脸上没有表情，只有手在动。

Constraints：发型变化只能发生在26.0s–26.4s之间。只有发型改变，Iaro的脸、服装、配饰必须与参考图完全一致。爆炸头禁止出现红色以外的颜色。

SHOT 9（28.0s–30.0s）｜【"真的假的？"】

Subject：Iaro，光标，小白

Action：28.0s，Iaro慢慢转身，用0.8秒转过来面向光标，爆炸头随转身轻微颤动。28.8s，Iaro停住，面无表情地瞪着光标，眉毛压低，嘴角下拉，长长地从鼻子呼出一口气。29.0s，光标在画面右侧左右轻快地摇摆两下，一副无辜的样子。29.3s，画面左下角，巨犬的眼睛盯住了这颗又圆又弹的红色爆炸头，脑袋一歪，尾巴越摇越快，前爪压低身体，摆出扑球前的预备姿势。29.6s，Iaro的眼珠慢慢斜向巨犬。30.0s定格。

Environment：巷子里的阳光打在爆炸头上，背景微虚。

Camera：50mm近景，Iaro在画面中央，胸部以上加爆炸头完整入画，光标在右侧边缘，巨犬的脑袋从左下角入画。镜头静止。

Style：喜剧节奏靠最后的停顿和眼神来出效果。

Performance："真的假的？"只靠表情：先是无语，再是警惕，绝不开口。

Constraints：禁止Iaro说话或张口。巨犬禁止真的扑上去，停在预备姿势。禁止出现字幕或文字。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NEGATIVE / 全片负面约束：

禁止任何文字、字母、数字、Logo、水印、字幕，禁止软件界面的文字菜单和工具栏。禁止对白和人声。禁止开场静止发呆。禁止Iaro的脸、服装、配饰偏离参考图或在镜头间漂移（只有SHOT 8的发型变化例外）。禁止假发套感的头发、塑料皮肤、浮肿卧蚕、CG蜡像脸。禁止变形带有恐怖、血腥或伤害感，巨犬禁止凶狠。禁止光标穿过人体，光标漂浮时必须有投影。禁止追逐方向反转。禁止物体悬空。禁止画面卡通化，所有编辑元素都必须像实物一样嵌在真实光线里。

entries.title: Alexa Grey 果汁廣告幕後花絮
entries.description: 身份圖優先於分鏡圖，30 秒中保留笑場與畫外導演台詞，並鎖定同一罐飲料。
entries.prompt:
WAN 3.0 IMAGE-TO-VIDEO | ALEXA GREY | 30-SECOND BTS COMMERCIAL

REFERENCE:
Use the attached Alexa Grey Character Sheet as PRIMARY identity reference and storyboard as SECONDARY visual reference. Preserve Alexa’s exact face, facial proportions, warm deep-brown skin, dark brown eyes, long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, layered gold necklaces and athletic/hourglass proportions. SAME WOMAN, SAME FACE, SAME IDENTITY throughout. Keep her orange beach outfit consistent.

PRODUCT LOCK:
One single orange juice energy drink can. Keep identical shape, size, orange/yellow packaging, label, artwork and material throughout. Same hand holding the product. No switching hands, redesign or deformation.

STYLE:
Photorealistic premium beverage commercial filmed as authentic BTS footage. Tropical beach, wet sand, ocean waves, palm trees, warm golden-hour sunlight, cinematic depth of field, realistic skin/hair and natural handheld camera movement. Alexa is confident, playful and spontaneous, not overly rehearsed.

IMPORTANT:
Alexa SPEAKS every line marked ALEXA. Generate accurate natural English lip-sync. Director is OFF-SCREEN only. No subtitles.

00:00–00:04
CAM: Handheld side tracking, starting low and tilting from her legs/waist toward face.
ACTION: Alexa walks along shoreline holding the drink naturally. She looks around at the ocean.
ALEXA: “Wow… this place is beautiful.”

00:04–00:08
CAM: Smooth front-side arc into medium close-up.
ACTION: Alexa notices the product is too low, raises it herself and turns the label slightly toward camera.
ALEXA: “Okay, let’s make this look good.”
DIRECTOR OFF-SCREEN: “Perfect. Just relax and be yourself.”

00:08–00:12
CAM: Medium close-up, subtle handheld push-in.
ACTION: Alexa gives an exaggerated commercial pose, immediately realizes it feels forced and laughs, covering her mouth.
ALEXA: “Okay… that was definitely too much.”
DIRECTOR: “Exactly! Keep that laugh.”

00:12–00:16
CAM: Lower tracking movement, rising naturally with her.
ACTION: Alexa lowers her hand, brushes her hair back and relaxes. A small wave reaches her foot. She looks down, surprised, then laughs.
ALEXA: “Oh! The ocean wants a cameo too.”
DIRECTOR: “Forget the pose. Just be Alexa.”

00:16–00:20
CAM: Follow laterally into a relaxed three-quarter angle.
ACTION: Alexa looks toward the ocean, takes a natural breath, then glances back at camera. Her expression becomes calm and confident.
ALEXA: “Honestly… this is more my kind of energy.”

00:20–00:24
CAM: Medium close-up framing Alexa and product, subtle push-in.
ACTION: Alexa rotates the can naturally so the front faces camera. She studies it for a moment, then smiles.
ALEXA: “Natural energy. Real juice.”
DIRECTOR: “Yes. That’s the shot.”

00:24–00:28
CAM: Smooth waist-up hero tracking shot.
ACTION: Alexa walks slowly toward camera, drink clearly visible. Hair moves naturally in the sea breeze. She looks directly into lens.
ALEXA: “Fresh energy… without trying too hard.”

00:28–00:30
CAM: Slow cinematic push-in to final hero close-up.
ACTION: Alexa stops, raises the drink slightly and gives a confident, genuine smile.
ALEXA: “Fresh energy. No pretending.”
DIRECTOR OFF-SCREEN: “Beautiful. That’s a wrap.”

END with Alexa and the orange juice energy drink clearly visible against the ocean sunset.

AUDIO:
Natural ocean surf, sea breeze, footsteps, clothing movement and subtle beach ambience. Premium upbeat commercial music gradually builds. Alexa’s voice is warm, conversational and confident. Director remains off-screen.

CAMERA:
Use handheld tracking, low angles, medium close-ups, subtle arcs, push-ins, three-quarter angles and smooth hero movement. Realistic motion blur, shallow depth of field, cinematic lensing and natural golden-hour lighting. No static shots.

PRODUCT:
The same orange juice energy drink must remain consistent in every frame. Keep packaging readable and unchanged. Final frames prioritize product visibility.

NEGATIVE:
NO face change, NO identity drift, NO duplicate Alexa, NO extra people, NO hairstyle change, NO skin-tone change, NO body distortion, NO extra fingers, NO malformed hands, NO hand switching, NO product deformation, NO packaging change, NO product duplication, NO outfit change, NO visible director, NO subtitles, NO gibberish, NO misspelled text, NO exaggerated acting, NO drinking, NO pouring, NO jump cuts, NO camera glitches, NO warped background.

FINAL FEEL:
A believable premium orange juice energy drink commercial that feels like genuine BTS footage from a real shoot. Alexa’s personality drives the commercial: confident, funny, natural and relatable. SAME ALEXA from first frame to last.

entries.title: SIPPO 櫻桃汁日系時裝廣告
entries.description: 包裝參考與四位人物分開固定，用 WHIP CUT 和 MATCH CUT 串接超現實東京場景。
entries.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
Premium 30-second Japanese cherry juice commercial: playful, surreal, fashion-forward, photorealistic and highly polished. Energetic pacing, Japanese fashion-ad aesthetics, creative HARD CUTS, MATCH CUTS and WHIP CUTS.

ACTIVE REFERENCE
<<<image_1>>> is the exact SIPPO Cherry carton reference. Preserve its matte powder-pink rectangular carton, folded top, white flexible straw, striped sunset symbol, dark-red SIPPO logo, Cherry label and two smiling cherries. Never change the packaging into another container.

CHARACTERS
Four adult Japanese women, 22–28, distinct hairstyles: black bob, raven ponytail with burgundy ribbons, copper-brown bob, waist-length black hair with blunt bangs. Tokyo fashion styling in cherry red, pink, ivory and chrome. Stable faces, natural skin and believable friendship.

FIRST FRAME
Carton already dominates the foreground with its full front panel readable; lead woman directly behind it. No establishing shot.

FORMAT MODE
Fast multi-shot commercial with consistent product, characters, wardrobe and color world. Every shot introduces a new visual idea.

ACTION AND CAMERA SEQUENCE
OPENING — 107° wide rectilinear shot. Carton fills foreground on glossy pink table. Lead woman smiles and points at straw as camera rapidly pushes in.

WHIP CUT — Camera bursts through a cherry-red circular portal into a surreal Tokyo studio street with pink tiles, cream walls, chrome rails and giant cherries. Four women walk toward camera in synchronized formation. 84° wide stabilized dolly.

MATCH CUT — Carton passes through a circular wall opening and emerges into another woman’s hands inside a burgundy/pink Japanese photo booth. Fast 180° orbit as she sips and side-eyes camera.

OVERHEAD — Four women form a radial composition around a cherry-red platform, passing the carton clockwise while camera rotates opposite. Two cherries roll across frame as transition.

MACRO INSERTS — Condensation, flexible straw, fingertips, glossy cherry, SIPPO logo and smiling cherry graphics. Product remains faithful to <<<image_1>>>.

LOW ANGLE — Four women surround the product pedestal. Camera rapidly cranes upward as they turn toward camera and break into natural laughter. Realistic hair and fabric motion.

FINAL GROUP — 84° wide cherry-red stage with giant circular sunset-inspired light. Each woman holds an identical carton and they perform a synchronized toast.

FINAL PACKSHOT — HARD CUT to cream-pink studio. Exact SIPPO Cherry carton on polished pedestal with two cherries beside it. Straw bends right. Slow premium telephoto push. Hold for brand recognition.

LIGHTING AND IMAGE QUALITY
Premium Japanese beauty-commercial lighting, soft overhead light, cherry-red edge light, pearlescent skin, powder pink/burgundy/cream palette. Photorealistic ARRI Alexa 35 look, natural grain, HDR, pristine commercial finish.

PHYSICS
Realistic carton weight and stiffness, natural finger pressure, flexible straw, gravity-driven condensation, believable hair, fabric and cherry motion.

AUDIO
Original upbeat Japanese electro-pop with female vocal chops, bass, claps and sparkling synths. Add synchronized carton taps, straw flex, cherry rolls, fabric swishes, whooshes and sip sounds. Final toast: “SIPPO Cherry!” End with a two-note sonic logo. No subtitles.

entries.title: 藍綠指甲油美妝廣告
entries.description: 10 秒安排 18 個短鏡頭，先固定人物、指甲與瓶身，再用微距、焦點轉移與匹配剪接。
entries.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 ultra-photorealistic luxury beauty commercial following all 18 storyboard shots in order. Keep one identical blonde model with messy tied hair, blue-gray eyes, freckles, glossy lips, natural skin and an off-shoulder Tiffany Blue dress. All nails are glossy turquoise, medium almond-shaped. One identical transparent glass nail-polish bottle with turquoise lacquer and silver cap. Pure white studio, soft beauty lighting, realistic textures, cinematic macro, smooth orbits, focus pulls and elegant match cuts. 0–0.5s: Extreme macro of glossy turquoise nails, slow orbit. 0.5–1s: Pull back revealing the same hand holding turquoise ice cream in a waffle cone. 1–1.5s: Reveal model behind ice cream, playful eye contact, focus shifts to face. 1.5–2s: Macro of two manicured fingers holding polish bottle, subtle push-in. 2–2.5s: Brush emerges from bottle with a realistic turquoise lacquer droplet. 2.5–3s: Extreme macro of brush smoothly applying glossy polish to one nail. 3–3.5s: Model playfully peeks from behind a giant turquoise macaron, focus pull to eye. 3.5–4s: Manicured fingers place a macaron onto a stack of three, tactile macro. 4–4.5s: Beauty portrait, model touches cheek with turquoise nails, slow push-in. 4.5–5s: Extreme nail macro transitions to matching turquoise macaron texture. 5–5.5s: Model playfully brings ice cream near lips, rotates cone, camera arcs 45 degrees. 5.5–6s: Both manicured hands elegantly frame polish bottle, slow macro push-in. 6–6.5s: Fingers lift a glossy turquoise ceramic cup, focus on nails. 6.5–7s: Close-up of glossy lips approaching turquoise macaron, rack focus to nails. 7–7.6s: Top-down shot of hand spreading five perfect turquoise nails across white surface. 7.6–8.2s: Model holds polish bottle at eye level, focus shifts from product to eyes. 8.2–9s: Overhead composition of polish bottle, turquoise macarons, ice cream and cup; manicured hand picks up bottle, gentle orbit. 9–10s: Final beauty hero portrait, model holds bottle beside face while other hand frames cheek, all nails visible, slow push-in and final hold. Maintain exact identity, colors, realistic hand anatomy, natural movement and product consistency. No extra people, objects, text or overlays

entries.title: 寫實幫派開放世界實機
entries.description: 30 秒第三人稱戰鬥之外，另外明列頭像、血條、任務欄與小地圖的位置。
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic open-world GANGSTER gameplay cinematic featuring two rival street gangs fighting in a gritty modern city at night. Make the entire video feel like a trending AAA gameplay recording, as if a player is actively controlling the main character.

GAMEPLAY SCREEN / HUD — VERY IMPORTANT:
Add a polished, original modern gameplay interface that stays visible naturally throughout the video:

Top-left: small circular character portrait + green HEALTH BAR and blue STAMINA BAR

Top-right: compact MISSION OBJECTIVE panel

Bottom-left: detailed MINIMAP, circular radar, player arrow, enemy indicators, nearby vehicle icons and objective marker

Bottom-right: transparent action-button icons for punch, dodge, sprint, interact and crouch

Center: small dynamic crosshair/aim indicator when appropriate

Enemy targets: red diamond markers above hostile characters

Teammates: blue/green indicators above friendly characters

Combat feedback: subtle hit indicator, combo counter and XP/reward notification

Mission notifications: sleek pop-up messages such as “RIVAL GANG DETECTED”, “SURVIVE THE AMBUSH”, and “BOSS FIGHT INCOMING”

Add subtle controller-style button prompts when the player approaches objects or enemies

HUD should be semi-transparent, futuristic and minimal, integrated naturally into the scene rather than covering the action.

UI animations should feel responsive: icons pulse, objectives update, health decreases realistically, enemy markers move with characters.

Make the interface original and not an exact recreation of any existing game UI.

0–5 SEC — RIVAL GANG DETECTED

Third-person camera follows the protagonist walking through a neon-lit city street.

HUD:
Minimap activates → several red enemy markers appear → objective panel displays:

MISSION
RIVAL GANG DETECTED

An enemy warning icon flashes briefly.

5–10 SEC — STREET FIGHT

A rival gangster attacks. The player-controlled protagonist blocks, dodges and counterattacks.

Show bottom-right action icons responding to the player's movements. Red enemy markers appear above opponents. Add a small COMBO ×3 indicator after consecutive successful moves.

10–15 SEC — CHAOS

The fight spreads across the street. Gang members run between cars and barriers.

The minimap becomes crowded with moving red and blue indicators.

OBJECTIVE UPDATED:
SURVIVE THE AMBUSH

Add subtle screen shake and damage feedback when the protagonist gets hit.

15–20 SEC — SLOW-MOTION COUNTER

The protagonist becomes surrounded. Gameplay suddenly enters dramatic slow motion.

A DODGE prompt appears near the bottom-right controls. He dodges an incoming attack and performs a counterattack.

The HUD smoothly returns to normal speed.

20–26 SEC — GANG WAR

Both gangs charge toward each other.

The protagonist runs through the battlefield while teammates fight alongside him.

OBJECTIVE:
DEFEAT THE RIVAL GANG

Show dynamic enemy markers, teammate indicators, minimap movement, stamina depletion while sprinting, and realistic combat feedback.

26–30 SEC — BOSS FIGHT

A black SUV arrives. The rival gang leader steps out.

All enemy indicators converge around him.

A dramatic BOSS HEALTH BAR appears across the top-center:

RIVAL GANG LEADER
████████████████████

Then a large original gameplay notification appears:

⚠ BOSS FIGHT INCOMING

The protagonist raises his fists. Camera moves behind him into a classic third-person gameplay position.

CUT TO BLACK.
entries.author: Ai Girllie

entries.title: 伊斯坦堡手機旅遊 Vlog
entries.description: 以自拍、逛市集與屋頂夕陽分段，手持晃動、自動對焦和曝光變化共同建立手機感。
entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second photorealistic smartphone travel vlog featuring a young Turkish woman exploring Istanbul on a warm summer evening. She wears a cute, elegant cream-colored linen dress with delicate embroidered details, a light patterned scarf loosely tied around her hair, small gold earrings, and a woven shoulder bag. Her look feels stylish, natural, and effortlessly Turkish.

The vlog opens in selfie mode as she walks through a lively historic Istanbul street, smiling at the camera while colorful shop signs, old Ottoman-style buildings, hanging lamps, and passing locals create an authentic atmosphere. She turns the camera toward a small street vendor and excitedly tries a freshly baked simit, then laughs and gives the camera an approving reaction.

She continues toward the Grand Bazaar, where she browses colorful handmade ceramics and shimmering Turkish lamps. She picks up a tiny mosaic lamp, holds it beside her face, and playfully asks the camera, “Should I take this home?”

Cut to her sitting at a rooftop café overlooking the Bosphorus at sunset, sipping Turkish tea while ferries glide across the water and seagulls pass overhead. She captures the view, then turns the phone back toward herself with the golden sunset behind her.

For the final moment, she walks along the waterfront as Istanbul's evening lights begin to glow. She smiles directly into the camera and says, “I think I’m already falling in love with Istanbul. See you on the next adventure!”

Authentic handheld smartphone footage, natural selfie-camera perspective, subtle camera shake, realistic autofocus and exposure shifts, genuine facial expressions, natural walking and hand movements, realistic skin texture, detailed fabric and jewelry, believable crowds and background activity. Authentic Istanbul ambience with ferry horns, distant conversations, footsteps, seagulls, street vendors and café sounds. Warm natural lighting, realistic sunset, cinematic but not overly polished. No beauty filter, no artificial skin, no exaggerated acting, no CGI appearance, no distorted hands, no text overlays. Maintain the exact same woman, outfit, hairstyle, facial features and proportions throughout the entire video.
entries.author: H A J R A

entries.title: 八〇年代屋頂派對衝刺
entries.description: 先用 CHARACTER CONTINUITY 鎖定造型，再排趕路場景，並排除現代車輛與建築。
entries.prompt:
Create a cinematic, ultra-realistic 1980s lifestyle story about a stylish young woman who has one goal: make it to a legendary rooftop dance party before the final song begins. The entire 30-second video follows her race through the city, building anticipation until she finally reaches the party.

CHARACTER CONTINUITY

The same young woman in every scene, identical face, hairstyle, body, makeup, and clothing.

She has voluminous wavy dark-brown hair, subtle 1980s makeup, gold hoop earrings, and a confident but expressive personality.

Exact same outfit throughout: oversized cream blazer with rolled sleeves, fitted black top, high-waisted light-wash jeans, white sneakers, black shoulder bag, and sunglasses.

SCENE 1 — THE GOAL | 0–7 SEC

Morning in a vibrant 1980s city. She receives an urgent handwritten note from her best friend: “ROOFTOP PARTY — 8 PM. DON’T BE LATE!”

She looks at the clock, realizes she is running out of time, grabs her shoulder bag, puts on her sunglasses, and rushes outside.

Quick cinematic close-up of the handwritten invitation, clock, her determined expression, and her sneakers hitting the pavement.

SCENE 2 — THE RACE | 7–14 SEC

She jumps into a classic 1980s car and races through the colorful city streets.

She checks the clock on the dashboard and realizes the party is getting closer to starting. She looks worried but determined.

Fast cuts: vintage traffic, neon signs, passing storefronts, her hands on the steering wheel, wind blowing through her hair, and the city rushing past the windows.

SCENE 3 — LAST CHANCE | 14–22 SEC

She arrives near the party but discovers the elevator is broken.

She grabs her bag and runs up a long staircase, climbing several flights toward the rooftop. Her friends are already waiting above, looking toward the door.

She reaches the final staircase, exhausted, then hears the distant sound of music starting.

She smiles and pushes herself harder.

SCENE 4 — THE PAYOFF | 22–30 SEC

The rooftop doors suddenly swing open.

She arrives just as the first beat of the final song begins. Her friends cheer excitedly and pull her into the party.

City skyline glowing behind them, colorful 1980s lights, dancing crowd, balloons, vintage speakers and neon decorations.

She laughs, removes her sunglasses, and joins the dance.

FINAL SHOT: The camera pulls backward as she dances confidently with her friends against the glowing city skyline. She looks directly into the camera with a triumphant smile.

VISUAL STYLE

Authentic 1980s cinematic lifestyle aesthetic, nostalgic 35mm film texture, subtle VHS imperfections, soft halation, practical neon lighting, realistic skin and hair, period-correct cars, architecture and props, energetic music-video editing, smooth tracking shots mixed with handheld movement, dramatic close-ups, natural expressions, premium fashion-commercial quality.

CRITICAL CONTINUITY: Same woman, identical face, identical hairstyle, identical outfit and accessories in all four scenes. The story must clearly communicate goal → urgency → obstacle → achievement.

No smartphones, modern vehicles, modern clothing, modern buildings, text overlays, subtitles, logos, watermarks, or futuristic objects.

entries.title: 西湖神女（首尾幀）
entries.description: 15 秒一鏡從水滴變神女，岩彩質感、青金配色與首尾幀共同限定變化方向。
entries.prompt:
【一镜到底，慢速唯美运镜，无剪辑，15秒长镜头，岩彩画矿物颜料质感与3D渲染碰撞，青蓝×鎏金撞色】
全局设定：国风岩彩画质感，矿物颜料颗粒肌理，金箔质感，青蓝与鎏金强烈撞色。场景为清晨薄雾中的西湖：湖面呈哑光青蓝晕染，金色晨光穿透云层形成丁达尔光柱，远处三潭印月的石塔与雷峰塔在雾中若隐若现，近处有荷叶与荷花。画面主体是西湖水神"西子"：岩彩画质感，鹅蛋脸，柳叶眉，丹凤眼，眉心一点朱砂花钿，肌肤如羊脂白玉泛着柔光，头后悬浮一轮淡金色圆光；高挽发髻插一支鎏金荷花发簪，她的裙摆与披帛由流动的湖水构成，青蓝色渐变，表面水光粼粼。
配音与音效：背景为轻柔的古筝与竹笛，环境音有细微的水波声与清晨鸟鸣。第8秒起，一位空灵温柔的女声缓慢吟诵："欲把西湖比西子——"；回眸段接下半句："淡妆浓抹，总相宜。"语速缓慢，带轻微回响，余韵悠长。
[0-3秒：一滴水]极近微距，清晨的荷叶边缘，一颗水珠凝聚饱满，映着金色晨光，缓缓坠落。镜头跟随水珠下摇（Tilt down），水珠滴入湖中，激起一圈金蓝色涟漪，涟漪层层扩散。
[3-7秒：水聚成形]涟漪中心，湖水缓缓隆起，凝聚成神女"西子"的身形：湖水化作她的青蓝色裙摆与半透明披帛，细小水流在她周身环绕流动。她从湖心缓缓升起，双眸轻闭又缓缓睁开，鎏金荷花簪亮起微光。镜头缓慢环绕（Orbit）她半垂的眼眸与流水织成的裙摆。
[7-11秒：一步一莲]她赤足踏在湖面上缓缓前行，每一步脚下都漾开一圈金色涟漪，涟漪中荷花次第绽放。镜头后撤拉远成中全景：薄雾散开，远处三潭印月的三座石塔亮起温暖灯光，雷峰塔在晨光中显现，岸边垂柳拂水。第8秒，女声旁白起："欲把西湖比西子——"她的披帛在身后拖出长长的金蓝色水光。
[11-15秒：回眸·总相宜]她停下脚步，回眸看向镜头，镜头缓缓推近至半身特写：晨光洒在她的脸上，湖水披帛在身侧轻轻飘动，几滴发光的水珠从发梢滴落，在空中化作细碎光点。旁白接下半句："淡妆浓抹，总相宜。"她浅浅微笑，身后是晨光中的雷峰塔与朦胧的三潭印月。最后一秒画面完全定格在她的回眸特写，定格为完美的电影海报构图。

entries.title: 水墨竹林刀客（首幀）
entries.description: 水墨首幀接 20 秒五段動作，白色墨痕刀光與最後文字一起寫進節奏。
entries.prompt:
(0:00 - 0:03) 运镜：中景。画面：沿用 图片1 的水墨竹林场景。头戴斗笠、身着墨色长袍的刀客，其剪影伫立在浓雾环绕、竹影婆娑的中心。动作：刀客左手轻按刀柄，竹叶随风飘落。氛围：寂静，压抑，水墨晕染的颗粒感清晰可见。
(0:03 - 0:08) 剧情引入，运镜：特写。剧情：刀客察觉杀气。画面：镜头快速推进到刀客斗笠下的特写。细节：斗笠边缘露出一双凌厉、决绝的眼睛，眼神如刀。水墨晕染的“汗珠”从额头滑落。动作：刀客右手缓缓握紧刀柄，指关节泛白。竹叶飘落的速度加快。
(0:08 - 0:13) 运镜：快速环绕。画面：镜头以刀客为中心快速环绕。剧情：两名同样是水墨剪影的刺客从竹林深处杀出，手持双钩和短刃。细节：刺客的动作也是水墨笔触构成的，如墨迹流动。镜头快速掠过刺客的身影，强调速度感。
(0:13 - 0:18) 运镜：手持感，高速捕捉。打斗：刀客猛然拔刀，刀光是一道纯白色的水墨裂痕。刺客双钩攻来。细节：一击：刀客回身一斩，刀刃与刺客双钩碰撞，迸发出无数黑白相间、带有书法感的火花和墨点。二击：刀客虚晃一枪，利用竹竿弹射，从高处劈下。刺客翻滚躲避。竹竿被打断，化作飞散的墨痕。三击：刀客刀尖直指另一刺客咽喉，刺客以短刃格挡，镜头捕捉刀刃与短刃摩擦时细微的墨迹崩裂细节。
(0:18 - 0:20) 运镜：慢镜头至定格。* 画面： 刀客的刀停在刺客颈侧，刺客凝固。* 细节： 刀客的斗笠在打斗中略微倾斜。竹林归于平静，更多竹叶飞舞。* 氛围： 镜头慢慢拉远，回到中景，定格在刀客收刀、刺客倒地的画面。* 文字（可选）： 画面下方显现水墨风文字：“江湖，不过一笔勾销。”风格说明： 整个过程保持 图片1 的高度黑白、水墨画风格，动作必须有毛笔触感，速度要快，细节要足（墨滴、火花、墨痕裂口）。

entries.title: 導演與演員一鏡到底
entries.description: 30 秒單鏡以快速搖鏡連接導演和演員，並具體描寫一秒內的表情落差。
entries.prompt:
镜头1 [0秒-30秒]
近景，平视视角，连续快速摇镜，一镜到底（单镜头连续无缝运镜）：
画面左侧是身穿黑色潮流导演马甲、戴着高档专业工作耳麦的导演，其左下方放置着一台巨大的专业电影摄像机。右侧是妆容精致、留着时尚韩式逗号刘海、身穿高定制西装的关系户小鲜肉。背景是宽敞的专业影棚拍摄现场，可见巨大的绿色幕布、数个高耸的影视级C型灯架、缠绕的电线，以及在背景中穿梭忙碌的灯光师和化妆师等工作人员。
专业影棚人工光。柔和的LED柔光箱光源从右侧洒入，将三位主角的面部均匀照亮，场景色彩饱满。背景的摄影器材与绿幕在充足的影棚灯光下投射出淡淡的阴影，呈现出真实而忙碌的现代化大制作片场质感。
镜头手持拍摄一镜到底，近景，镜头一开始，拍摄导演，导演无所谓的表情，瞥了一眼画面右侧斜前方画外的一眼关系户小鲜肉，对他下达指令，说道：“媒体故意黑你，做个表情看看”。说完后镜头快速右摇到关系户面部近景，镜头不要切镜，关系户小鲜肉，面部朝向画面左侧斜前方画外导演方向，神色自若，眼神真挚而自信。他嘴唇微动，神情专业地向对方阐述到““就这种事情来说，情绪可以有好几种”，说话时，头部伴有极其轻微的自然晃动，说完后镜头快速左摇到导演面部近景，镜头不要切镜，导演思索了一下，一边挑衅似地歪了歪头，向关系户小鲜肉说到““狗仔爆料你深夜幽会”，导演说完台词后，镜头迅速右摇到小鲜肉面部近景，不要切镜，关系户小鲜肉，面部朝向画面左侧斜前方画外导演方向，并快速进入表演状态，他眉头紧锁，眼神慌乱、焦急地快速游移，随后他狠狠地咬紧下唇，闭上双眼，整张脸（虽带着精致妆容）因极度的焦虑而紧绷，完美呈现出面对偶像生涯毁灭时，内心惊恐、紧张交织的挣扎状态。表演完后， 镜头再次迅速左摇到导演近景，不要切镜，导演面部表情微变，语速加快，说到““媒体又帮你洗白了，说那是你亲姐！”导演说完后，镜头再次迅速右摇到小鲜肉近景，镜头不要切镜，镜头中，关系户小鲜肉，面部朝向画面左侧斜前方画外导演方向，他的表情在千分之一秒内完成神级转换。他先是面部一滞，随后双眼猛地眯起，嘴角极大程度地咧开，露出一排白皙的牙齿，展露出一个极其夸张、甚至有些变形的狂喜笑容。这种“星途尽毁的绝望”与“彻底摆脱束缚”交织的疯魔情绪在他脸上扭曲呈现。角色表演完后，镜头再次迅速左摇到导演近景，镜头不要切镜，导演说到“你亲姐向媒体透露，你是领养的”，导演说完后，镜头再次迅速右摇到小鲜肉近景。镜头不要切镜，镜头内，关系户小鲜肉面部朝向画面左侧斜前方画外导演方向，只见他双眼暴睁，眼球凸出，精心修剪的眉毛高高扬起，嘴巴震惊地张成“O”形。紧接着，他的嘴角再次无法克制地向上拉扯，露出一副不可思议、惊魂未定却的复杂神态。 角色表演完后，镜头再次快速左摇到导演近景，镜头不要切镜，紧接着导演露出有点惊讶的表情说到“其实你是千亿豪门真少爷”。导演说完，镜头再次随即迅速右摇到小鲜肉近景，镜头不要切镜，镜头内，关系户小鲜肉面部朝向画面左侧斜前方画外导演方向，他瞬间爆发出极度魔性的狂喜。他整个人激动得微微颤抖，双眼笑得眯成了一条缝，双手甚至抬起至胸前，双手小幅度快速连续鼓掌，身体前倾摇晃，将一夜暴富、无法自持的癫狂喜悦演绎得淋漓尽致。 角色表演完后，镜头再次快速左摇到导演近景，镜头不要切镜，导演说到“你姐卷款跑路”导演说完，镜头再次迅速右摇到小鲜肉近景。小鲜肉面部朝向画面左侧斜前方画外导演方向，只见他的双眼再次瞪大，瞳孔颤抖，嘴角向下耷拉，神情在一秒钟之内从天堂坠入地狱，写满了惊愕、痛苦与不知所措。画面最后定格在这个表情上。

entries.title: 廢土加油站女牛仔
entries.description: 先給梗概，再按 0–6 到 24–30 秒拆解給馬加草的笑點，讓反轉有前後鋪陳。
entries.prompt:
内容梗概
这是一场发生在色彩明亮的未来废土上、充满了冷幽默与荒诞感的“加油”事件。在一个被遗忘的、类似66号公路的加油站，百无聊赖的工作人员迎来了一位奇特的客人——一个骑着真马的酷酷女牛仔。就在工作人员以为这只是个路过的疯子时，女牛仔却径直走向加油机，拿起油枪，为她的马“加满”了新鲜的青草。这超现实的一幕，让见多识广的工作人员彻底陷入了认知失调的呆滞状态。
场景描述与光影美学
视觉风格: 写实风格，色彩处理上采用高饱和度、高亮度的电影调色，营造出一种“晴朗”感，让荒诞的故事发生在一个无比正常、甚至有点美好的环境里。
色彩美学: 严格遵循明亮的“青橙配色”体系。
青色（Teal）: 万里无云的天空是明亮、清澈的蔚蓝色（偏青）。加油站的主要建筑是复古的黄橙蓝配色，建筑微微褪色。加油机是褪色的复古红。
橙色（Orange）: 地面是龟裂的橙色干涸土地。远处的山脉呈现出温暖的赤陶色。女牛仔的围巾或夹克是橙色的。
角色与场景:
女牛仔: 形象酷飒，沉默寡言。戴着一顶宽檐牛仔帽。穿着耐磨的工装靴和牛仔裤，身上有长途旅行的风尘痕迹。
马: 一匹神态淡定、毛色普通的真马，仿佛对这一切早已司空见惯。
加油站工作人员: 穿着油腻的蓝色工装，戴着一副巨大的黑色墨镜，百无聊赖地靠在椅子上，嘴里叼着一根牙签。他是本片的核心“反应镜头”担当。
加油站: 经典的66号公路风格，旁边有一个小小的便利店，门口放着一台褪色的可乐贩卖机，充满了美式复古感。
运镜风格描述
运镜风格是“冷静的旁观与荒诞的特写（Calm Observation & Absurd Close-up）”：
大量使用固定的中景镜头和缓慢的横移，以一种非常冷静、客观的视角来记录事件，不做任何情绪引导。
在关键的荒诞行为发生时，镜头会突然给到一个极端的特写，比如油枪喷出草的瞬间，或者工作人员呆滞的面部表情，通过这种突兀的放大来制造笑点。
分镜描述
0s - 8s：序幕：无聊的午后
大全景（固定）。蓝天，风沙。一个复古的黄橙蓝配色微微褪色的加油站孤独地立在公路旁。加油站门口，一个工作人员戴着墨镜，懒洋洋地躺在椅子上打盹。一切都安静得只剩下风声。
远景。地平线上，一个骑着马的女牛仔缓缓出现，打破了这份宁静。
中景。工作人员被马蹄声惊醒，他扶了扶墨镜，不耐烦地坐直了身体，看着这个奇怪的组合，嘴里叼着的牙签动了动，脸上写满了“又是个问路的”。
8s - 16s：破：一本正经的胡闹
女牛仔没有说话，她利落地翻身下马，牵着马，径直走向一台老式的加油机。马儿熟练地将头伸到加油机旁。
工作人员的主观视角（略带鱼眼）: 镜头模仿他从墨镜后看出去的视角，那个女人和马的组合显得更加古怪。他看到女牛仔真的拿起了加油枪。
近景。工作人员的眉头皱了起来，他觉得这女人在寻开心。他摘下了墨镜，准备开口呵斥。
慢动作特写: 就在他摘下墨镜的瞬间，他看到女牛仔将油枪的喷嘴对准了马嘴，然后扣动了扳机。
16s - 24s：急：【高潮】认知崩溃的瞬间
【终极反差】:
特写: 油枪喷嘴。喷出的不是汽油，而是一股股新鲜翠绿、还带着水珠的青草！
极端特写: 镜头快切到工作人员那张呆若木鸡的脸上。他的眼睛瞪得像铜铃，嘴巴微微张开，叼着的牙签都忘记了动弹。他的表情凝固了，仿佛世界观在这一秒被彻底颠覆。
中景。马儿吃得津津有味，幸福地眯上了眼睛，然后心满意足地、有力地甩了一下尾巴。马尾扫起的灰尘，正好扑了旁边还在呆滞的工作人员一脸。
24s - 30s：合：绝尘而去，留下呆滞
“加满”了草。女牛仔将油枪挂回原位。她从口袋里掏出几枚硬币，走到便利店门口，“叮叮当当”地扔进了柜台上的一个铁皮罐子里。
她回头看了一眼还在石化状态的工作人员，帽檐下的嘴角似乎微微上扬了一下。
【终极定格】: 她翻身上马，绝尘而去。
镜头缓缓推向工作人员。他依然保持着那个呆若木鸡的姿势，满脸灰尘，手里还捏着刚刚摘下的墨镜，嘴里的牙签终于“啪嗒”一声掉在了地上。
定格在他这张怀疑人生的脸上，全片在荒诞的寂静中结束，只留下一阵风吹过时，牙签在地上滚动的声音。

entries.title: 毛絨宇宙冒險
entries.description: 20 秒讓布、紐扣與拉鏈同時參與材質和逃生動作，FPV 運鏡強調尺度。
entries.prompt: 20秒超宽银幕毛绒宇宙冒险片段，整体采用超精细毛绒材质、电影级太空尺度、可爱外形与强烈动作反差、夸张FPV运镜和真实软体物理。一艘由毛绒布、纽扣、拉链与填充棉制成的宇宙飞船，载着兔子、狐狸和乌鸦三只小型毛绒动物，在由巨大毛线行星、绒毛星云和布偶巨兽组成的宇宙中高速逃亡。一只覆盖深蓝长绒毛、眼睛像两枚玻璃纽扣的巨大星际鲸兽从星云中追赶飞船。动态包括拉链飞船弹射起航、贴着毛线行星高速绕行、巨鲸从后方冲出、穿越纽扣小行星带、被鲸兽吞入体内、沿金色拉链从背部逃出、巨鲸如泄掉填充棉般缓慢变扁、最终穿越粉紫色绒毛星云向彩色纽扣太阳飞去。

entries.title: 溫馨兒童房
entries.description: 10 秒四段以夜燈安撫怕黑的小怪獸，柔和音效與搖籃曲配合表情轉變。
entries.prompt:
Heartwarming Pixar-style 3D animated scene, 10 seconds, vertical 9:16. A child's cozy bedroom at night, moonlight through the curtains, toys scattered on the rug. Under the bed hides a big fluffy purple monster with round glowing eyes, tiny horns, floppy ears, and soft teddy-bear fur, trembling and hugging a small stuffed bunny.

0–3s: Slow push-in under the bed. The monster peeks out nervously as the hallway light clicks off, plunging the room into darkness. It gasps and pulls its blanket over its head, eyes wide with fear.
3–6s: Creaky floorboards and a ticking clock. A shadow from the closet makes the monster squeak and shiver, its fur puffing up. It whimpers softly.
6–8s: A small hand reaches down from the bed holding a glowing star-shaped night-light. The monster blinks, then slowly smiles as warm golden light fills the space beneath the bed.
8–10s: The monster happily cuddles its bunny and the night-light, sighing in relief, and gives a sleepy yawn as the child's hand pats its fuzzy head. Twinkling music box melody.

Soft cinematic lighting, cozy and funny, expressive character animation, smooth motion, gentle sound effects and soothing lullaby score.

entries.title: 鐘
entries.description: 15 秒由海底鐘聲引出沉城升起，先用聲音鋪陳，再以光和尺度揭曉。
entries.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic live action, night photography, low-key lighting, deep teal and black water, warm practical lantern glow, film grain.
One old fisherman sits alone in one small wooden rowboat on a perfectly still black sea under a starless sky. One oil lantern hangs from the boat.

0-5s: The fisherman sits in silence, holding a line in the water. The sea is flat like glass, reflecting the lantern. The viewer is wide and low across the water. Sound: total quiet, a faint creak of wood.

5-10s: A deep church bell rings from somewhere far below the water. Ripples spread out from beneath the boat. The fisherman slowly leans over the edge and looks down. The viewer looks down past him into the water, where hundreds of faint golden lights glow in the depths.

10-15s: An entire sunken city rises around the boat, stone towers and rooftops breaking the surface on all sides with water pouring off them, every window lit with lanterns. The boat now floats in a flooded city street. The fisherman stands, staring up at the glowing bell tower directly in front of him as the bell rings again. Sound: the bell, rushing water, then stillness.

Negative prompt: cartoon, 3D animation, stylized, CGI look, extra people, extra boats, distorted hands, text, watermark, slow motion, flickering, warped buildings

entries.title: 那扇門
entries.description: 15 秒三段用畫出的門連接小巷與美術館，35mm 質感保持魔幻場景的實拍基礎。
entries.prompt:
Style: cinematic magical realism, soft overcast daylight, rich color, 35mm film look, shallow depth of field.

0-5s: One woman in paint-stained overalls paints a bright red wooden door onto a plain brick wall in an empty alley, the brush strokes thick and wet, the viewer behind her shoulder.

5-10s: She finishes the brass doorknob with a final stroke, sets down her brush, reaches out, and the painted knob turns in her hand, the painted door swings open into warm golden light, the viewer following her as she steps through.

10-15s: She steps out of a large framed painting hanging on the wall of a quiet art museum, landing on the polished floor, two visitors holding brochures freeze and stare at her, she nods politely and walks past them.

Negative prompt: more than one woman, more than two visitors, duplicate people, cartoon style, graffiti, text, watermark, slow motion

entries.title: 城市跑酷追逐
entries.description: 30 秒追逐由高處向下移動，反覆強調重量與重力，讓翻越動作有落地感。
entries.prompt:
A dramatic 30-second cinematic parkour chase following one elite male athlete descending through an ancient Italian seaside town built vertically into a steep mountain. Every cut places him farther downhill toward the sea. Keep the same bell tower, roofs, cliffs and harbor visible from progressively lower elevations. Photorealistic feature-film cinematography, anamorphic lens character, natural motion blur, subtle grain and rich Mediterranean color.

Consistent athlete: handsome Mediterranean man, late 20s, lean powerful build, olive complexion, short dark curls, light stubble. Faded charcoal athletic T-shirt, rust-red training trousers, black wrist wraps and dark parkour shoes. A world-class competitive parkour athlete: explosive, fearless, fast and technically precise. Never looks at camera.

0.0–3.5s: Epic drone shot above an old Italian town clinging to the mountain. Ochre, rose, cream and faded-blue buildings plunge toward a fishing harbor and cobalt sea. Terracotta roofs, stone stairs, arches, balconies, cypress and bougainvillea form a vertical maze. Dark clouds crown the mountain while sunlight breaks across the water. The athlete stands on a high roof, studies the route, then launches into a sprint as the drone dives after him.

3.5–7.8s: First hero stunt, uninterrupted wide side-tracking shot, entire body visible. He accelerates across a sloping roof and commits to a long roof-to-roof precision jump over a broad open alley. Show the complete takeoff, airborne distance and landing. He lands on the narrow edge of the lower roof, absorbs the force, regains speed and continues downhill. The sea flashes far below.

7.8–12.0s: Second hero stunt, one continuous descending cat leap. Camera tracks beside and below him. He sprints off the roof toward a building several feet lower, flies across the street, catches a wrought-iron balcony with both hands and plants both feet against the wall. Without pausing, he pulls himself over the railing and vaults onto a lower terrace. Show full body, clear height difference, powerful grip and convincing momentum.

12.0–16.5s: Third hero stunt across a multi-level market square. A stabilized low camera races parallel. He bursts through an arch, accelerates toward a broad stone fountain and performs a long diving kong vault over its full width. His legs pass cleanly between his arms before he launches beyond the fountain into a substantial drop to the lower plaza. He lands in a fast shoulder roll, rises immediately and races onward as pigeons explode into the air.

16.5–21.0s: Fourth hero stunt down a deep exterior stair canyon. Wide crane view keeps his whole body visible. He runs along a high stone railing, jumps to the opposite wall, plants one foot high against the stucco, pushes away and clears the stairwell to a landing several levels below. He lands on both feet, converts the impact into a roll and continues toward the harbor. The camera drops with him, revealing the sea filling the background.

21.0–25.7s: Cliffside finale. Waves crash against black rocks below. In one tracking shot, he races down the last cliff path, vaults a chest-high stone barrier and launches into a dramatic running front flip over the descending harbor steps. Show the full rotation in profile, his body isolated against the silver-blue sea, then a firm landing on the lower promenade. He runs out of it as sunlight breaks beneath the clouds and turns the coast gold.

25.7–30.0s: The speed gives way to intimacy. Ground-level medium-wide beside the sea. He slows and stops at the water’s edge, breathing hard. A lovely Mediterranean woman in her late 20s waits near the surf, with wavy dark-brown hair, pale-yellow summer dress and flat sandals. She hears him, turns naturally and gives him a warm smile. His intensity softens into a relieved smile. He walks toward her while wind moves her hair and dress. End with a slow pull-back as they meet beneath the town rising above them.

Camera: fast stabilized pursuit, wide side tracking, descending crane moves and sweeping coastal reveals. Never crop him during a stunt or cut between takeoff and landing. Keep him fully visible during every major move. Preserve constant downhill direction and make the sea larger after every transition.

Color and mood: terracotta, ochre, limestone, Mediterranean blue, storm-grey, white spray, rust red and warm gold. Urgent, athletic, exhilarating, romantic and triumphant, like a major action-film climax.

Maintain his exact face, hair, physique and clothing. One athlete only. No duplicates, teleportation, upward travel, timid hops, ordinary jogging, easy playground vaults, broken anatomy, extra limbs, costume changes, text, logos, cars or crowds. The woman appears only in the final shot. Powerful human gravity and weight, 24 fps cinematic motion,  16:9, exactly 30 seconds.
entries.author: Just Me

entries.title: 孤獨的檔案管理員建築奇幻之旅
entries.description: 角色參考與節奏參考分開處理，只借素材的鏡頭節奏；原作者提示出自 @rovvmut_。
entries.prompt:
A cinematic architectural odyssey following a solitary older female archivist through an immense abandoned coastal city. Photorealistic, ultra-high detail, sophisticated filmic color science, anamorphic lens character, subtle film grain, deep atmospheric perspective, rich natural contrast. Match the reference only in pacing, camera language, visual scale, and seamless montage structure. Do not reproduce its landscapes, traveler design, vehicles, or compositions.

Consistent subject: Tall Black woman in her early 60s, lean build, close-cropped natural silver hair. Long burnt-orange weatherproof coat, slate-blue scarf, charcoal trousers, black leather gloves, worn black ankle boots, compact dark-brown archival satchel worn across her body. Calm, purposeful presence. She never looks at the camera and is always studying the abandoned city.

Shot-by-shot timeline with precise pacing and camera language:

0.0–1.8s
Wide static shot transitioning into a very slow push-in. The woman stands alone in the center of a monumental abandoned railway terminal. The vaulted glass roof is partially broken, allowing pale morning light and fine rain to enter. A thin layer of water covers the marble floor, producing a vast mirror reflection. Empty platforms and silent iron arches recede into atmospheric haze. Her burnt-orange coat is the only warm color in the frame. Camera creeps forward and rises slightly, emphasizing the immense scale of the terminal around her.

1.8–3.1s
Low rear tracking shot at medium-wide distance. She walks steadily through a canyon-like avenue between enormous brutalist concrete towers. Wind drives loose paper and rainwater across the pavement. Long elevated walkways disappear into low cloud between the buildings. Her coat moves heavily in the wind while her satchel remains secure. Slight organic camera sway, controlled and deliberate, following several steps behind her.

3.1–4.2s
Locked-off symmetrical wide shot inside a ruined opera house. The woman stands ankle-deep in perfectly still water at the center aisle, facing the distant stage. Rows of faded crimson seats emerge from the reflective water. Torn velvet curtains move almost imperceptibly beneath a collapsed ceiling filled with cold blue daylight. Her reflection remains clear and undisturbed. Quiet, solemn, architectural stillness.

4.2–5.9s
Smooth aerial pull-back with a slight orbit. Begin close behind the woman on the roof of the opera house, then reveal the entire drowned city surrounding her. Concentric avenues have become dark canals. Pale stone towers, domed civic buildings, abandoned bridges, rooftop gardens, and a massive curved seawall extend toward the ocean. Low cloud spills between the tallest structures. The woman becomes a tiny burnt-orange point within the immense geometric city. Floating, stable drone movement.

5.9–7.8s
Night sequence, extreme wide shot. A single vintage crimson tram travels slowly left-to-right across a high steel viaduct above flooded streets. The woman appears only as a small silhouette inside one illuminated window. A silent violet electrical storm flashes behind the skyline, briefly revealing cranes, antennas, distant towers, and rain suspended in the air. The camera remains locked. Reflections of the tram lights stretch across the black water below. No explosions, destruction, or frantic motion.

7.8–9.0s
Golden-hour peak shot. The woman stands on a vast rooftop communications deck surrounded by enormous weathered parabolic antennas. She faces left toward the ocean, one gloved hand resting on her satchel. The antennas form monumental circular silhouettes against glowing amber and rose-colored clouds. Warm rim light outlines her silver hair and orange coat. Slow, subtle push-in. Gentle coastal wind moves her scarf.

9.0–11.6s
Epic aerial tracking shot. A crimson tram moves along a curving elevated railway between monumental skyscrapers and across broad sections of the flooded city. Below, geometric plazas, narrow canals, rooftop forests, empty bridges, and pale stone towers extend toward a brilliant blue sea. The camera flies parallel to the tram and slightly above it, then gradually pulls farther away until the tram becomes a small moving line within the city. Crisp daylight, deep blue sky, scattered sculptural clouds, smooth high-speed drone motion.

11.6–14.0s
Intimate point-of-view from inside the stationary tram. The edge of a dark window frame and softly reflected interior lights remain out of focus in the foreground. Outside, the same woman stands alone on an elevated platform, her burnt-orange coat, slate-blue scarf, brown satchel, silver hair, and black gloves unchanged. She holds a large translucent architectural map against the light and studies the distant flooded skyline through it. The city remains sharp beyond her, with white towers, blue water, and rotating antennas under late-afternoon light. A gentle breeze moves the map and her scarf. She never turns toward the camera.

Overall cinematography and technical direction:
Camera language: contemplative locked wides, slow creeping push-ins, controlled rear tracking, seamless floating aerial reveals, and one intimate vehicle-interior point of view. Stable, elegant motion throughout. No fast cutting, whip pans, shaky footage, abrupt zooms, or direct-to-camera performance.

Lighting progression: pale rainy morning, severe white overcast, cold blue interior light, violet electrical night, amber golden hour, crisp coastal daylight, soft late-afternoon light.

Color science: steel blue, wet charcoal, oxidized copper, faded crimson, and pale stone, unified by the woman’s burnt-orange coat. Subtle anamorphic flare, realistic reflections, restrained halation, fine cinematic grain, natural skin texture, volumetric weather, and deep atmospheric separation.

Mood: quiet discovery, lost human grandeur, the scale of architecture against one small observer, melancholy without horror.

Maintain exact character, wardrobe, coat color, satchel, age, body proportions, and facial identity in every appearance. No additional people. No readable text, logos, subtitles, signs, fantasy creatures, modern traffic, or post-apocalyptic debris piles. 24 fps cinematic motion, realistic physics, 4K detail, 16:9 widescreen.

entries.title: 機甲高速穿越巨型都市
entries.description: 30 秒飛行以密集都市製造速度與尺度，負向詞排除模型玩具感和卡通物理。
entries.prompt:
30-second cinematic high-speed mecha flight sequence through a dense futuristic megacity.

A single sleek advanced humanoid mecha in compact high-speed flight configuration, dark metallic armor with subtle white panels, small glowing blue thrusters, aerodynamic silhouette, consistent design throughout the entire video. No other mecha, no combat, no weapons firing.

The scene takes place in a gigantic futuristic city at late afternoon, with extremely tall skyscrapers, glass curtain walls, steel structures, elevated highways, rooftop machinery, signs, antennas and narrow urban canyons. Realistic large-scale architecture, cinematic lighting, physically believable reflections and motion blur.

The main goal is extreme sensation of speed, dangerous proximity to architecture, immersive camera movement, strong parallax, and realistic inertia.

Use clear hard cuts every 3 seconds while preserving the same mecha, same city, same lighting, and continuous direction of travel.

[00:00-00:03]
24mm ultra-wide lens.
Low rear chase camera, flying only several meters behind the mecha.
The mecha accelerates violently through a narrow canyon between skyscrapers.
Building walls are extremely close on both sides.
Windows, beams, pipes and signs rush past the edges of frame at enormous speed.
Strong foreground parallax.
Camera vibration from turbulent air, subtle realistic handheld instability.
The mecha remains sharp while the nearby architecture streaks with motion blur.

[00:03-00:06]
Hard cut.
Side tracking shot, extremely close to the right side of the mecha.
Camera flies parallel to the mecha only a few meters away.
The mecha skims along a huge glass skyscraper wall with less than one meter of visual clearance.
Rows of windows flash past like rapid horizontal stripes.
The camera almost brushes the wall.
Extreme sensation of dangerous proximity and speed.

[00:06-00:09]
Hard cut.
Front three-quarter tracking shot, camera flying backward ahead of the mecha.
18mm wide-angle lens.
The mecha rapidly approaches the camera while weaving between structural beams connecting two buildings.
Camera struggles to maintain distance and slightly drifts from inertia.
Foreground beams suddenly whip past the lens.
The city behind the mecha compresses into a dense high-speed tunnel.

[00:09-00:12]
Hard cut.
High overhead camera looking almost vertically downward.
The mecha suddenly dives between two enormous skyscrapers.
Camera follows the dive with a slight delay, then aggressively tilts downward.
The city streets far below become visible.
Extreme vertical depth, strong scale contrast, rapid acceleration.

[00:12-00:15]
Hard cut.
Rear chase camera returns.
The mecha approaches the corner of a massive skyscraper at seemingly impossible speed.
At the final moment it banks nearly 90 degrees and turns tightly around the building corner.
The camera does not rotate perfectly with the mecha; it reacts about a fraction of a second late, rolls violently, overshoots slightly, then corrects.
The building wall fills most of the frame during the turn.
Very strong near-miss feeling.

[00:15-00:18]
Hard cut.
Camera mounted extremely low and slightly behind the mecha.
The mecha races beneath an elevated highway and between gigantic concrete support columns.
Columns repeatedly flash past the camera only meters away.
Strong rhythmic foreground occlusion.
The camera shakes from high-speed air pressure and narrowly avoids the structures.

[00:18-00:21]
Hard cut.
Static cinematic camera positioned beside a skyscraper facade.
For the first moment the city appears almost calm.
Suddenly the mecha blasts past the camera from background to extreme foreground at tremendous speed, passing only a few meters from the lens.
Violent motion blur and air distortion during the flyby.
The camera rapidly whip-pans to follow it after it has already passed.

[00:21-00:24]
Hard cut.
Long-lens 85mm tracking shot from another rooftop.
The mecha threads through a dense sequence of skyscraper gaps at extreme speed.
Because of the compressed perspective, buildings appear stacked dangerously close together.
The camera pans rapidly, momentarily losing the mecha behind foreground buildings, then catching it again.

[00:24-00:27]
Hard cut.
Ultra-wide chase shot again, now even closer to the mecha.
The mecha enters an impossibly narrow corridor between two glass towers.
Both walls occupy the left and right edges of frame.
Reflections of the mecha rapidly slide across the glass.
The camera stays directly behind it while the entire environment becomes a tunnel of streaking architecture.
Maximum visual speed.

[00:27-00:30]
Hard cut.
The mecha suddenly exits the narrow skyscraper canyon into a gigantic open section of the city.
The camera follows behind and then rapidly pulls farther back.
The claustrophobic close architecture disappears, revealing an enormous futuristic skyline stretching to the horizon.
The mecha continues accelerating forward into the open city.
Strong contrast between the previous confined high-speed flight and the sudden huge open space.
End on a dramatic wide cinematic composition.

Visual direction:
photorealistic cinematic CGI, premium science-fiction film quality, realistic materials, realistic atmospheric perspective, physically believable high-speed motion, strong foreground parallax, natural motion blur, subtle lens distortion, volumetric sunlight, realistic glass reflections, enormous architectural scale, detailed futuristic megacity.

Camera behavior:
the camera should feel like a physical flying camera with mass and inertia.
It should not perfectly lock onto the mecha.
During rapid turns, the camera reacts slightly late, overshoots, rolls, shakes and corrects naturally.
Nearby objects should pass extremely close to the lens to emphasize speed.

Maintain strict temporal consistency:
same mecha design in every shot,
same armor proportions,
same thruster locations,
same lighting conditions,
same city architecture style,
same direction of travel,
correct scale between mecha and buildings.

Avoid:
slow motion,
floating or weightless movement,
gentle cruising,
perfectly stabilized camera,
static centered framing,
camera clipping through buildings,
mecha clipping through architecture,
changing mecha design,
extra limbs,
deformed geometry,
random transformation,
additional robots,
combat,
explosions,
weapons fire,
unmotivated camera teleportation,
tiny-looking buildings,
miniature city appearance,
cartoon physics.

entries.title: BMX Juice 搞笑電視廣告
entries.description: 30 秒 16:9 廣告把品牌口號、人物笑點與寫實攝影結合，另附負向清單。
entries.prompt:
30 second TV commercial for BMX Juice. 16:9, 1080p, 24fps, live-action cinematic comedy, bright sunny suburban cul de sac. Star: a heavyset 40 year old man with a sweaty mustache and beer belly, wearing a too-tight neon green spandex bodysuit, orange fanny pack, tiny red helmet, one pink knee pad.

0–5s: Drone shot: high aerial over the street, then fast dive down to the man. He straddles the tiny BMX bike, sniffs a bottle of BMX Juice, looks at camera.

5–10s: Low angle tracking shot. He chugs BMX Juice, throws the bottle, pedals furiously. Bike squeaks. He hits a plywood ramp. 

10–15s: Drone orbit shot, mid-air. Slow motion 120fps. His face goes from confident to panic. Spandex rips. Juice droplets float. 

15–22s: Extreme slow motion. The bike separates from him. He flails like a starfish. A pigeon flies past, also slow motion, looking disappointed.

22–27s: Real-time crash into a giant pile of leaves. Leaves explode. He sits up, dazed, leaf on his face, holds up a fresh BMX Juice bottle. 

27–30s: Product shot: BMX Juice bottle on the tiny BMX bike. Text overlay: "BMX JUICE." Tagline: "Get Juiced. Get Wrecked." Audio: funny ukulele, whoosh, squeak, slow-mo rip, thud, upbeat jingle.

Negative prompt: no watermark, no distorted face, no extra limbs, no cartoon, no low quality, no subtitles unless specified.

entries.title: 鬧劇喜劇三模型對比
entries.description: 15 秒 9:16 手機手持風同題比較 Seedance 2.5、Wan 3.0 和 MiniMax H3。
entries.prompt:
A 15-second high-energy slapstick comedy video with a handheld smartphone aesthetic, 9:16 vertical frame.

[0-4s] In a cozy living room,  AhKit sits on the sofa rubbing his sore neck.  Mia stands behind him, smiling angelically at the camera while playfully rubbing her small fists together. Subtitle: "When she offers a massage..."

[4-9s] Snap zoom. Mia cheerfully taps her small fist onto AhKit's shoulder. Sudden dynamic shockwave impact: AhKit's eyes bulge out in dramatic exaggerated horror, his body recoils violently, and he collapses off the sofa onto the floor in hilarious defeat. Subtitle: "CRITICAL HIT! -9999"

[9-15s] Low-angle tracking shot. Mia's sweet face turns into a sinister, villainous mischievous smirk. She grabs AhKit by one ankle with one hand and effortlessly drags him across the wooden floor toward a bedroom doorway. AhKit lies face down, frantically clawing the wooden floor with both hands like a terrified cat refusing to go into the room, legs sliding helplessly. Subtitle: "Ah Kit: Help... ...!"
entries.format: 提示詞 15 秒／9:16（原帖為三模型並排對比片）

entries.title: 懸崖被龍追擊跳水（失敗案例）
entries.description: 氛圍、分鏡與音效分區寫，同一人物參考和提示另比 Seedance 2.5；這條保留失敗經驗。
entries.prompt:
整體拍攝氛圍與色澤設定 (Global Atmosphere & Color Palette)
整體氛圍： 好萊塢極限動作災難片質感、IMAX 史詩級電影畫幅、極度逼真且帶有沉浸感的手持跟拍、高緊張感與強烈生死壓迫感、自然運動模糊（Motion Blur）與真實底片顆粒感。
色澤與光影： 採用強烈的冷暖色調對比（Teal & Orange Dynamic Grading）。背景以冰冷暗藍色、深灰冷霧為主，交替黑龍吐息噴出的熾熱亮橙色火光；自然體積光（Volumetric Lighting）穿透煙塵，高動態範圍（HDR），微距捕捉角色皮膚汗水、濕髮與冰屑的細節反射。
鏡頭 1：寒潭驚魂（0-8 秒）
時間： 00:00 - 00:08
動作： 一男一女寶藏獵人在冰冷漆黑的洞穴寒潭中極速涉水狂奔，表情極度恐懼、喘著白霧。身後巨龍猛然撞碎洞壁衝出，張開巨口咬向鏡頭。女子滑倒，男子猛力拉起她繼續向前狂奔。
運鏡： 低角度極速倒退手持跟拍（Low-Angle Tracking Shot），鏡頭緊貼水面微幅震動；巨龍衝出時碎石與水花直接砸向鏡頭，形成極強臨場感。
音效： 刺骨的水花潑踐聲、兩人急促粗重的喘息與尖叫、洞穴深處震撼胸腔的龍吼、巨石崩塌砸入水中的沉悶撞擊聲。
鏡頭 2：雪坡極速滑降（8-16 秒）
時間： 00:08 - 00:16
動作： 兩人衝出洞口踏上陡峭雪坡，順勢高速向下滑降與跳躍，避開巨石與枯木。巨龍從空中俯衝，身後火球炸裂，冰塊與火碳飛濺。男子側身撲倒女子，剛好閃過巨龍的巨爪撕裂。
運鏡： 正面俯角高速倒退跟拍（High-Speed Backward Tracking），伴隨強烈搖晃與動態模糊；火球爆炸時畫面出現劇烈 Lens Flare（鏡頭光暈）與煙霧衝擊。
音效： 冰雪極速摩擦的沙沙聲、火球呼嘯而過的空氣撕裂聲、巨幅爆炸轟鳴、刺耳的風聲與龍翼撲空的高頻風噪。
鏡頭 3：生死密林穿梭（16-24 秒）
時間： 00:16 - 00:24
動作： 兩人衝入濃霧密林，在巨木間急轉彎穿梭，彎腰躲避藤蔓。飛鳥與鹿群驚慌散飛。巨龍直接撞碎兩側大樹追擊，木屑與燃燒的樹枝旋轉砸向鏡頭。
運鏡： 中特寫主觀跟隨鏡頭（Dynamic Medium Tracking），在樹木間快速穿堂掠影；當木屑飛向鏡頭時，畫面順勢產生瞬時模糊。
音效： 樹幹被暴力撞碎的巨響、狂暴的木材折斷聲、受驚鳥群急速拍翅離去的嘈雜聲、火焰燃燒樹冠的烈火呼呼聲。
鏡頭 4：峽谷懸崖絕命一跳（24-30 秒）
時間： 00:24 - 00:30
動作： 兩人衝出森林進入絕壁峽谷，兩側岩石崩落。面對盡頭的萬丈懸崖與下方急流，巨龍張口撲來，男子緊握女子的手毅然跳下懸崖，砸入湍急河流中；隨後兩人在水面浮起，仰望崖邊咆哮的巨龍。
運鏡： 鏡頭先平行跟拍，在兩人跳崖瞬間轉為高速下搖（Tilt Down）跟隨重力俯衝，隨後入水（Submerge）並迅速出水，最後定格為低角度仰拍（Low-Angle Shot）兩人濕透的面部特寫。
音效： 碎石落山的滾動聲、兩人縱身一躍的短暫風聲停頓（無聲片刻）、落水時巨響的入水聲與水下悶音、出水後湍急的水流聲與崖頂傳來的遙遠龍吼。

entries.title: 吹奏樂部三人動畫（對比 Seedance 2.5）
entries.description: 三張圖分別固定人物與樂器，30 秒合奏要求對應不混亂，另與 Seedance 2.5 比較。
entries.prompt:
<<<Image1>>> は Girl A の顔、黒髪の肩上ボブ、青い瞳、体格、制服デザインを定義する。Girl A は標準語を話す真面目な吹奏楽部員で、担当楽器はクラリネット。白背景や元のポーズは継承しない。

<<<Image2>>> は Girl B の顔、茶髪ポニーテール、体格、制服デザインを定義する。Girl B は関西弁を話す明るい吹奏楽部員で、担当楽器はトランペット。白背景や元のポーズは継承しない。

<<<Image3>>> は Girl C の顔、ダークブラウンのボブヘア、体格、カーディガンを含む制服デザインを定義する。Girl C は博多弁を話すおっとりした吹奏楽部員で、担当楽器はフルート。白背景や元のポーズは継承しない。

この3枚の参照画像は3人の別々の女子生徒を定義する。主要人物はこの3人のみ。顔、髪型、衣装、担当楽器、方言、性格を混同しない。

夏休みの高校の吹奏楽部を描く、爽やかで自然な日常アニメ映像。舞台は夏の朝の音楽室。窓の外は強い日差し、青空、校庭の緑。室内には譜面台、椅子、楽器ケース、扇風機、開いた窓、少し揺れるカーテン。外から蝉の声が聞こえる。空気は少し暑く、夏休みの学校らしい静けさがある。字幕なし、ナレーションなし。

全体のカメラ方針：
自然なマルチカット構成。1カットごとに目的を持たせる。引きの状況説明、寄りの仕草、手元の演奏、表情のリアクションを交互に見せる。人物を棒立ちにしないため、会話中も視線移動、重心移動、髪の揺れ、汗をぬぐう、譜面を見る、楽器を持ち直す、息を吸う、指を動かすなどの小さな動作を常に入れる。カメラは不自然に激しく動かさず、ゆるいドリーイン、軽いパン、短い横移動、自然なカットつなぎで構成する。演奏中は表情、指、口元、楽器、視線のやり取りを細かく切り替える。

全体の音：
蝉の声、教室の環境音、椅子を引く音、楽器ケースを置く音、扇風機の回転音、カーテンが揺れる気配、楽器を持つ音、短いチューニング音、息づかい、そして短い合奏。

0〜5秒 — 登場と状況説明
カット1：
音楽室の中を外の窓側から見たやや広めの引き。カメラはゆっくり前進する。朝の光が斜めに差し込み、窓辺のカーテンが揺れている。Girl A は譜面台の前で譜面を見ている。Girl B はドア側から入ってきて、少し前かがみで暑そうにしている。Girl C は楽器ケースを机に置く。

カット2：
Girl A の胸上のミディアムショット。譜面から目を上げ、2人を見る。クラリネットの部品を持ちながら落ち着いて言う。
Girl A が標準語で言う：
{おはよう。最初のフレーズ、合わせよう。}

終了状態：3人ともそれぞれの準備に入る空気になる。

5〜10秒 — 暑さと夏休み感
カット3：
Girl B のミディアムショット。カメラは少し右から寄る。Girl B は制服の襟元を軽くつまみ、片手であおぐようにしながら、汗をぬぐって言う。ポニーテールが少し揺れる。
Girl B が関西弁で言う：
{音楽室あっつ！}

カット4：
扇風機の回転を一瞬映すインサート。続いてカーテンが揺れるカット。夏の空気を見せる。

カット5：
Girl C のやや寄りのミディアムショット。Girl C は楽器ケースを開けながらふっと笑い、フルートを取り出して言う。
Girl C が博多弁で言う：
{でも夏休みの部活って感じやね。}

終了状態：3人の気分がそろい、練習モードに入る。

10〜15秒 — 準備と合図
カット6：
手元の短いモンタージュ。テンポよく3つの短いカットをつなぐ。
- Girl A がクラリネットを組み立てる指先の寄り
- Girl B がトランペットのバルブを軽く押して感触を確かめる寄り
- Girl C がフルートを水平に持ち、キーに指を置く寄り

カット7：
3人の半身が入る横並びのミディアム3ショット。カメラはゆっくり左から右へ小さくスライドする。3人が譜面台に向き直る。Girl A は譜面を見てから2人を見る。Girl B は姿勢を正し、Girl C は小さくうなずく。

カット8：
Girl A の顔寄り。目線で合図し、小さく息を吸って言う。
Girl A が標準語で言う：
{いくよ。}

終了状態：3人が同時に吹き始める直前。

15〜24秒 — 合奏メイン
演奏パートは会話よりも長く取り、部活らしい集中を見せる。カメラはテンポよく切り替えるが、空間の向きは崩さない。

カット9：
3人を正面から捉えたミディアム3ショット。合図と同時に演奏開始。最初の1〜2秒はこのカットで、3人が同時に入る瞬間を見せる。息を吸ってから音を出す流れを自然に見せる。

カット10：
Girl A のクラリネットの手元と口元の寄り。指が動き、真剣な視線が譜面へ向く。

カット11：
Girl B のトランペットのややローアングル寄り。ベルの輝き、頬の張り、バルブを押す指の動き、リズムに少し乗る体の揺れを見せる。

カット12：
Girl C のフルートの横顔寄り。フルートの水平ライン、指先、落ち着いた息遣い、やわらかな目線を見せる。

カット13：
再び3人の斜め前からの3ショット。カメラがわずかにドリーインし、3人の音がまとまっていく感じを見せる。演奏中、Girl A は譜面と2人を交互に見て、Girl B は少し楽しそうに吹き、Girl C は安定して支える。

カット14：
短いリアクション挿入。Girl A の目線、Girl B の口元、Girl C の指先をリズムよく短く切り替えて、演奏の躍動感を出す。

終了状態：フレーズを吹き終え、音が止まり、3人が手応えを感じる。

24〜27秒 — リアクション
カット15：
演奏直後の3ショット。音が止まり、一瞬だけ静けさ。Girl B が顔を上げて、嬉しそうに笑う。Girl A は少しほっとし、Girl C はうなずく。

カット16：
Girl B の寄り。トランペットを少し下ろして、明るく言う。
Girl B が関西弁で言う：
{今のええやん！}

終了状態：3人が「もう一回いける」という前向きな空気になる。

27〜30秒 — 締めの再演奏
カット17：
Girl C のミディアム寄り。フルートを構え直し、笑顔で短く言う。Girl A が少し笑い、Girl B もすぐ構え直す。
Girl C が博多弁で言う：
{このままいけるばい。}

カット18：
すぐに3人の正面ミディアム3ショットへカット。最後の2秒ほど、もう一度だけ短いフレーズを揃えて演奏する。今度は最初より自然に息が合っている。カメラはごくゆるく前進する。

カット19：
締めの短い寄り。演奏を終えたあと、3人が顔を見合わせて笑う。夏の光が差し込む音楽室で、前向きな空気のまま終わる。

全編の連続性ルール：
Girl A は常に標準語を話し、常にクラリネット担当。
Girl B は常に関西弁を話し、常にトランペット担当。
Girl C は常に博多弁を話し、常にフルート担当。
各キャラクターの顔、髪型、衣装、性格、方言、担当楽器を全編で一定に保つ。
主要人物は3人のみ。追加の部員を主役として出さない。
夏の朝の音楽室、照明、暑さ、学校の雰囲気を全編で維持する。
会話中は口だけでなく、視線、肩、手、重心移動、髪の揺れなども自然に動かす。
演奏中は息を吸う、指を押さえる、楽器を支える、体が少し揺れるなど、演奏に伴う自然な身体動作を入れる。
字幕、テロップ、ナレーション、ファンタジー演出、衣装変更、キャラ入れ替わりは禁止。

entries.title: 平安京百鬼夜行（對比 Seedance 2.5）
entries.description: 參考圖固定妖怪造型，逐 Cut 寫夜間行進，日語音效與無 BGM 的設定保持氣氛。
entries.prompt:
【映像仕様】
超高品質な実写。平安時代の日本。夜の平安京。日本妖怪による本物の百鬼夜行。
BGMなし。日本語音声。SEあり。字幕、テロップ、ロゴ、透かし、読める文字なし。
参照画像の妖怪、ぬらりひょん、建築、色、質感、体格を全Cutで正確に維持。水平反転禁止。
中国仙侠、西洋モンスター軍団、ゾンビ軍団、ゲームCG、普通の人間の仮装行列にしない。
百鬼夜行は暴走や襲撃ではない。何百もの妖怪が巨大な一つの行列として、整然と同じ方向へ進む。
妖怪を一体ずつ見せる紹介PVにしない。どのCutでも、近景・中景・遠景に複数種類の妖怪を同時に入れ、「数百体いる」ことを一目で理解させる。
地上・屋根・空の三層すべてに妖怪を存在させる。
巨大な一つ目入道、土蜘蛛、牛鬼、鳥型天狗、獣妖、長い首の妖怪、付喪神、怪火、小型妖怪を大量に混在させる。
最重要は「数」「空間占有率」「ぬらりひょんと百鬼のサイズ差」。
同じ画を長く維持しない。ただし細かく切りすぎず、各Cutで必ず新しい情報が増えるようにする。
記述のない自然な動き、視線、呼吸、衣の揺れ、群れの連動、空気感を、場面の意図に沿ってプロの映画監督として自然に補完する。
────────────────────
【Cut 1｜0:00–0:03｜朱雀大路の全貌】
────────────────────
夜の平安京。
朱雀大路を真上に近い超高所俯瞰で捉える。
一直線に並ぶ松明の火。
その間を埋め尽くす、何百もの妖怪の大行列。
最初は「行列」として見えるが、下降し始めるにつれて、それが普通の人間ではなく異形の群れだと分かり始める。
通りだけでなく、左右の屋根にも妖怪。
夜空にも怪火と飛行妖怪。
カメラ：超ワイド俯瞰から、ゆっくり下降開始。
SE：低い足音の地鳴り、遠い翼音、火の爆ぜる音。
────────────────────
【Cut 2｜0:03–0:06｜異形の行列だと分かる】
────────────────────
下降を続けながら中ワイドへ。
列の輪郭が明確になる。
角。
長い首。
巨大な一眼。
獣の背。
器物の異形。
近景・中景・遠景に別種の妖怪が重なり、通り全体が妖怪で埋まっている。
一体ずつ止めて見せず、「行列全体」が異形であることを一気に理解させる。
カメラ：下降のまま前方へわずかに寄る。
SE：大小の足音、木と金属の付喪神が触れ合う音。
────────────────────
【Cut 3｜0:06–0:09｜地上の密度】
────────────────────
地上アイレベル。
手持ち気味に前進。
巨大妖怪の胴体、提灯を持つ付喪神、獣妖の尾がレンズ前を次々横切る。
視界の抜ける先にも、まだ何十列もの妖怪が続いている。
画面のどこを見ても人間ではない。
行列は乱れず、同じ方向へ静かに進んでいる。
カメラ：手持ちの前進ワイド。
SE：すぐ近くの足音、衣擦れ、提灯の揺れる音。
────────────────────
【Cut 4｜0:09–0:12｜足元と下層の異形】
────────────────────
低い位置。
石畳の足元。
無数の脚が通る。
下駄、獣の爪、多脚の節足、裸足、器物の小さな足。
引きずられる古皿の付喪神。
一反木綿の長い裾が地面近くを流れる。
小型妖怪が大型妖怪の足元をすり抜ける。
密度はさらに増し、画面下半分がほとんど脚と影で埋まる。
カメラ：超ローアングルで前進。
SE：石畳を打つ多数の足音、皿が擦れる音、布が流れる音。
────────────────────
【Cut 5｜0:12–0:15｜ぬらりひょん初登場】
────────────────────
カメラが一気に跳ね上がる。
ローアングル。
百鬼の壁の中央に、ぬらりひょんの全身。
60代。痩せ。瓢箪頭。薄い髪。短い髭。黒い直衣。閉じた扇。
周囲の巨大妖怪に比べると極端に小さい。
しかし本人だけは何の力みもなく、近所を歩く老人のような自然な足取りで進む。
後ろには地上・屋根・空まで続く百鬼の壁。
カメラ：ローアングル全身。
SE：周囲の重い足音の中に、ぬらりひょんの小さな下駄の音。
────────────────────
【Cut 6｜0:15–0:18｜ぬらりひょんの顔】
────────────────────
ぬらりひょんの顔から胸。
歩きながら閉じた扇を一度だけ軽く開き、すぐ閉じる。
視線だけが静かに前を見ている。
威圧しない。怒鳴らない。余計な大芝居もしない。
大物なのに、本人だけ妙に力が抜けている。
ぬらりひょん（扇を一度だけ軽く開いて閉じ、目だけ前方へ向けたまま、静かに低く）：「夜の都は、こちらが借りる」
カメラ：顔〜胸の中寄り。
SE：扇の開閉音、下駄の足音、遠い火の音。
────────────────────
【Cut 7｜0:18–0:21｜左右の列が整う】
────────────────────
軸を保ったままドリーバック。
ぬらりひょんを中央に置き、左右の百鬼が整然と並んで画面を埋める。
一つ目入道、牛鬼、土蜘蛛、長首、付喪神、獣妖が左右両側に層を作る。
整列しているのに、圧迫感だけが増していく。
屋根の妖怪も進行に合わせて同じ方向へ移動し、空の怪火も列に沿って流れる。
カメラ：中央軸を保ったドリーバック。
SE：連続する足音、翼音、火。
────────────────────
【Cut 8｜0:21–0:25｜都全体を包む火と百鬼】
────────────────────
クレーンアップ。
大路だけでなく横巷まで見える。
火の点が都の中を走っているように見える。
そこに無数の妖怪の列が重なり、京全体が百鬼夜行に包まれていることを見せる。
屋根の影にも妖怪。
遠景にもまだ終わりが見えない。
「一つの通り」ではなく、「都全体を百鬼が通過している」印象を出す。
カメラ：上昇しながら広がる俯瞰。
SE：地響きのような足音、火、遠い鈴。
────────────────────
【Cut 9｜0:25–0:28｜朱の門へ近づく】
────────────────────
門前ワイド。
フレーム上半分を大きく朱の門が占める。
手前から奥へ続く百鬼の行列。
ぬらりひょんの後ろ姿。
閉じた扇を持ち、自然な足取りで門へ向かう。
左右にも百鬼。
列はまったく途切れない。
カメラ：門前の正面ワイド。
SE：下駄の音、百鬼の足音、火。
────────────────────
【Cut 10｜0:28–0:30｜門を抜ける】
────────────────────
同じ位置のまま。
ぬらりひょんが門をくぐる。
その後ろからも百鬼の列は切れず、まだ続いている。
ここで止める。
「終わらない百鬼夜行が京へ入っていく」印象を残して終了。
カメラ：固定ワイド。
SE：足音、鈴、火。BGMなし。

entries.title: 火車上的邂逅
entries.description: 連續鏡頭靠紅傘與二十年前的台詞揭露關係，低聲對話與無音樂維持克制。
entries.prompt: Generate a single continuous shot focused on natural human performance. Nearly empty commuter train at 2:00 a.m., moving through a rain-soaked city. A tired Black woman in her early forties sits opposite an older Asian man holding a familiar red umbrella. Reflections from passing streetlights move realistically across the windows and their faces. The camera begins in a wide symmetrical composition, then slowly dollies toward the woman as she recognizes the umbrella. Her expression changes subtly from fatigue to uncertainty and finally quiet recognition. Without looking directly at him, she asks softly, “Where did you get that umbrella?” The man studies her for a moment and replies, “You gave it to me twenty years ago.” Hold on her restrained reaction rather than exaggerated shock. Grounded contemporary drama, realistic commuter lighting, wet glass, muted blue-gray palette with red as the only strong accent, natural micro-expressions and body language. Audio: train wheels, rain against glass, distant station announcements without intelligible words, quiet American English dialogue. No music.

entries.title: 紙地圖找地標（風格化動畫）
entries.description: 30 秒 16:9 以圖片鎖定角色與畫風，全片只留一聲 Hey，讓動作負責敘事。
entries.prompt:
Generate a 30-second, 16:9 animated short: a young woman searches a hill town for a landmark with a paper map.

ART STYLE — hold this exactly in every frame, it is the contract: painterly 3D concept art. Sculpted readable silhouette. Planar cheek structure and wedge-shaped hands. Directional hand-painted brush patches locked to the 3D surfaces, never floating. Rough matte cloth. Ivory light anchor against deep oxblood architecture, with cobalt accents. Broad morning key with a restrained rim. 50mm eye-level framing. Layered staging: foreground, character plane, background. NO plastic skin, NO smooth airbrush, NO floating brush texture, NO photorealism, NO gradients, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no extra people beyond those described.

CHARACTER: @Image1 is the woman and the style authority. One original adult courier — long asymmetrical face, cropped silver-black bob, ivory ankle-length coat with oxblood piping, cobalt satchel. Keep her face, hair, coat and satchel identical in every frame. Her expression arc runs from breezy confidence, through mounting frustration, to defeat, to startled indignation, to open joy.

Shot 1 [0-5s]: THE MAP. She stands in a hill-town tram plaza unfolding a paper map far too big for her arms, kiosk stone steps and one wind-bent tree behind her. She turns the map ninety degrees, then upside down.
Shot 2 [5-11s]: THE FIRST GUESS. She strides off down a side street, map held out in front of her like a shield, counting buildings under her breath — and arrives at a blank stone wall. She looks up at it, then back at the map.
Shot 3 [11-17s]: THE SECOND GUESS. She rotates the map and sets off the other way, weaving through market stalls and a fountain square, stepping over a cat, checking the map against a street sign that plainly does not match.
Shot 4 [17-21s]: GIVING UP. She stops dead in the middle of the plaza. The enormous map sags in her hands. Her shoulders drop. She blows a strand of hair off her face, beaten.
Shot 5 [21-25s]: THE BUMP. A passer-by clips her shoulder hard as they hurry past. She staggers half a step, snaps her head round after them, indignant, and calls out sharply: "Hey!" — young female voice, irritated, clipped.
Shot 6 [25-30s]: THE REVEAL. Mid-turn she stops dead — because the landmark she has been hunting is standing directly behind her, enormous, filling the frame. Hold close on her face: her eyes blink once, twice, the irritation draining out of them; her mouth opens slightly; and the expression blooms slowly into an unguarded joyful smile. The camera then pulls back in one continuous move to a wide shot — she stands small at the base of the landmark, her back to camera, head tilted up, looking at it. The map hangs forgotten at her side. Hold on the wide.

CAMERA: tracking shots at her shoulder through the searching beats; locked and still for the defeat; a fast whip round with her on the bump; then one continuous accelerating pull-back for the final reveal that never decelerates before the last frame.

AUDIO: light playful woodwind-and-pizzicato score that stumbles with each wrong turn, drops out completely on the bump, and resolves into one warm full phrase as she smiles. Hill-town ambience, paper crinkling, footsteps on stone, market chatter, a tram bell in the distance. The only dialogue in the entire video is her single word: "Hey!".

entries.title: 漂浮城市下的巨物
entries.description: 30 秒先建立黑海上的漂浮城市，最後才揭露承載整座城的活體巨物。
entries.prompt: Create a 30-second cinematic sci-fi short set in a mysterious floating city above a dark, endless ocean during a violent nighttime storm. Build the story around escalating anticipation, visual clues, and a shocking final reveal.0-5 seconds: Begin with an enormous wide shot of the floating city barely visible through thick storm clouds. Lightning briefly illuminates the skyline. The city appears completely abandoned. Rain falls heavily and the ocean below is unnaturally still.5-10 seconds: Slowly descend into the empty city. Flickering lights activate one by one along deserted streets, moving deeper into the city as if something is approaching. A distant mechanical rumble grows louder. No people are visible.10-15 seconds: Follow the lights toward the edge of the city. The camera looks down through the clouds. Far beneath the ocean surface, an enormous circular light suddenly appears. The entire floating city trembles.15-20 seconds: Everything goes completely dark. The storm stops for a moment. The ocean below begins rotating in a gigantic perfect circle. Buildings shake as deep mechanical sounds emerge from beneath the water. Cracks of blue light spread across the ocean surface.20-25 seconds: The camera rapidly pulls backward and upward. Massive structures begin rising from beneath the ocean, initially appearing to be enormous towers. The floating city starts moving upward with them.25-30 seconds: Final reveal. Pull far enough back to reveal that the "floating city" is actually a tiny structure built on the back of a colossal humanoid-like machine that has been lying dormant beneath the ocean for centuries. Its enormous head rises from the darkness, its eyes slowly opening beneath the storm clouds. The city is revealed to be only a small civilization living on its back.End on the creature looking toward the horizon as lightning illuminates its full silhouette.Visual direction: photorealistic cinematic sci-fi, dark storm atmosphere, massive scale, realistic rain and ocean simulation, volumetric clouds, eerie blue illumination, deep shadows, abandoned futuristic architecture, subtle camera shake, slow controlled camera movement that accelerates during the reveal, realistic reflections, cinematic depth of field, high-detail environments, 4K, 24fps.Important: Keep the creature completely hidden until the final 5 seconds. Do not show obvious clues that reveal its true form too early. The audience should initially believe they are watching a floating futuristic city, then realize in the final moments that the entire city has been sitting on something alive and unimaginably enormous.
entries.author: Brie AI

entries.title: 爺爺被 AI 美女痛打
entries.description: 兩張圖分別鎖定主角與對手，跟拍移動戰鬥並以高速親吻收尾；作者註明參考 M7。
entries.prompt:
参照画像は2人分ある。
参照画像1は主人公の20代前半の女性。
参照画像2は対戦相手の成人男性。

主人公は必ず参照画像1の女性にする。
対戦相手は必ず参照画像2の男性にする。

2人とも、顔立ち、髪型、髪色、体格、身長バランス、年齢感、肌の質感、雰囲気を参照画像どおりにできるだけ忠実に維持する。別人化しない。過度に美化しない。顔や体格をランダム化しない。2人の同一性を最優先する。

15秒、16:9、実写フォトリアル。日本を舞台にしたシネマティックで真剣な高速格闘シーン。コミカルな演技やバラエティ的な演出にはしない。本気の映画アクションとして描く。ただし、戦闘技として突然「高速キッス」が何度も挟まる。この高速キッスだけが異様な要素だが、登場人物自身は一切ふざけず、必殺技の一種として扱う。

映像は35mm映画フィルムのような質感。自然なフィルムグレイン、わずかなハレーション、柔らかなハイライト、深い黒、落ち着いた自然な色調、微細なレンズフレア、映画用レンズらしい自然なボケ。デジタル的にシャープすぎず、過剰なHDRやCM調にはしない。日本映画の本編から切り出したようなシネマティックなレンズトーン。文字、字幕、ロゴ、HUDなし。

主人公は参照画像1の20代前半の日本人女性。普段は普通の若い女性に見えるが、戦闘開始後だけ常識外れの超高速格闘能力を発揮する。表情は終始真剣。笑わない。ふざけない。対戦相手は参照画像2の成人男性。男性も最後まで真剣に戦う。驚きや困惑は見せても、大げさなコミカル表現にはしない。

ロケーションは毎回ランダムに変更する。昔ながらの商店街、住宅街の細い路地、大型ショッピングモール、スーパーマーケット、コンビニ前、駅前広場、地下街、飲食店や店舗の店内、ホームセンター、観光地の参道など、日本国内の日常的な場所を選ぶ。必要に応じて通行人、買い物客、店員、学生、会社員、観光客などが自然に存在する。背景人物は主役にせず、戦闘が始まると驚いて振り返る、立ち止まる、距離を取る、道を開ける程度の自然な反応にする。

格闘技の内容も毎回ランダムに組み合わせる。高速前蹴り、高速回し蹴り、ローキック、足払い、膝蹴り、掌底、肘打ち、中国拳法風の連続掌打、八極拳風の短距離突進、太極拳風の受け流し、柔道の崩し、体落とし、小外刈り風の足技、腕を取って体勢を崩す動き、高速ステップ、高速フェイントなどを複数組み合わせる。同じ技だけを連打しない。

映像全体の最重要構造は固定する。

「高速移動 → 一瞬だけ実体化 → 格闘技 → 即離脱 → 別方向から再接近 → 突然急停止 → 高速キッス → 即離脱 → 再び高速格闘」

この反復を15秒間、高密度で繰り返す。

高速キッスは絶対に省略しない。最低5回程度入れる。各キッスのたびに顔の超接近アップを0.2〜0.4秒程度だけ短く差し込む。キッスの直前まで激しく高速移動しているのに、唇が接触する瞬間だけ突然時間が止まったように人物が鮮明になり、接触を明確に見せる。直後には即座に高速で離脱し、そのまま格闘へ復帰する。

キッスの前に長く見つめ合わない。恋愛的な間を作らない。キッス後に照れない。笑い合わない。色気を強調しない。キッスそのものも本気の格闘の中に組み込まれた異様な接触技として扱う。男性は毎回驚くが、コミカルな顔芸にはしない。驚愕と困惑を短く見せた直後に本気で反撃しようとする。

この戦いは同じ場所に固定しない。対峙した開始地点から、戦いながら少しずつ位置を移動していく。攻防のたびに2人の立ち位置がずれ、前進、後退、横移動、回り込み、押し込み、回避によって、画面内の背景が少しずつ変化していく。商店街なら店先から通路中央へ、通路中央から別の店の前へ、ショッピングモールなら柱やベンチやエスカレーター付近へ、スーパーなら通路沿いに移動しながら、路地なら奥へ流れながら戦う。戦闘全体を通して、2人は周囲の環境の中を移動し続け、ひとつの定位置で格闘し続けない。主人公だけでなく、男性も押し返し、踏み込み、かわし、よろけ、追いながら位置を変える。結果として15秒の間に戦場の重心が少しずつ移動していく。

カメラワークも固定しない。カメラは1か所に置いた固定撮影ではなく、戦いに合わせて常に位置と向きを変える。前進、後退、横移動、斜め移動、回り込み、追従、遅れて追うリフレームを自然に組み合わせる。ワイドで全体を捉えた直後に少し寄り、別の角度へずれ、また追いかける。2人の移動に合わせてカメラも数歩分動いてついていく。時には男性の肩越し、時には主人公寄り、時には2人の進行方向に合わせて並走する。カメラ自体を無意味に高速回転させたり、同じ構図を固定し続けたりしない。戦いながらロケーションの別の部分が見えてくる、空間の中を一緒に移動している感覚を出す。16:9の横長画面を活用し、左右方向の移動、距離感、追従感をしっかり見せる。

0.0〜1.5秒。主人公と男性が至近距離で対峙している。両者とも本気の構え。主人公は静かに鋭く男性を見据える。男性も警戒しながら構える。場所に通行人や客がいる場合、まだ周囲は日常の状態。緊張感のある静かな導入。カメラはミディアム〜ややワイドで2人を捉えつつ、完全固定ではなく、じわりと寄るか、わずかに横へ動いて緊張感を高める。

1.5〜2.1秒。男性が先に踏み込む。腕を伸ばす、掴みにいく、蹴りを出す、打撃を仕掛けるなど、毎回違う攻撃を開始する。その瞬間、主人公が突然異常な速度で加速。身体に強いモーションブラーと残像が生じ、男性の攻撃線を紙一重で外しながら一瞬で顔面付近へ入り込む。ここで2人の位置は開始地点から少しずれる。カメラも遅れて追い、横へ流れる。

2.1〜2.4秒。第1高速キッス。突然、顔の超接近アップ。高速移動が完全に止まり、主人公が男性へ一瞬だけキッスする。唇の接触が明確に見える。男性は目を見開く。0.2〜0.4秒だけ鮮明に見せる。

2.4〜3.0秒。キッスを離した瞬間、主人公はすでに高速離脱。男性だけが一瞬その場に残され、驚愕したまま次の方向を探す。主人公の残像が別方向へ走る。男性はそれに引っ張られるように数歩動き、戦場の位置がさらにずれる。カメラもその移動に合わせてリフレームする。

3.0〜3.3秒。第2高速キッス。別方向から主人公が突然真正面へ実体化。顔の超接近アップへ瞬時に切り替わり、再び短いキッス。すぐ離れる。

3.3〜4.5秒。ワイドまたはミディアムへ戻り、高速格闘。主人公が男性の周囲を猛烈な速度で移動しながら、高速蹴り、足払い、掌打、中国拳法風の連撃、柔道の崩しなどからランダムな技を連続で差し込む。1つの動作を長く見せず、0.2〜0.4秒程度の短いアクションを連続させる。男性も本気で防御し反撃する。2人は攻防しながら少しずつ移動し、開始地点とは違う背景が見えてくる。カメラも並走、斜め追従、回り込みを混ぜて追う。

4.5〜4.8秒。第3高速キッス。激しい高速移動の途中で突然主人公が男性の顔の目前へ停止。顔の超接近アップ。短く明確なキッス。直後すぐ高速離脱。

4.8〜5.4秒。高速格闘再開。男性が反撃しようとするが、主人公は側面、背後、正面へ高速で位置を変え、攻撃をかわしながら技を差し込む。強い残像、風圧、衣服の揺れ。男性もそれに合わせて踏み替え、向きを変え、押し戻され、2人はさらに別の場所へ移る。カメラも止まらず一緒に動く。

5.4〜5.7秒。第4高速キッス。再び超接近アップ。キッスだけ一瞬完全に止まり、すぐ高速離脱。

5.7〜8.4秒。ここは高速格闘の密度を最大化する。主人公が男性の周囲を高速で回り込み、0.2〜0.4秒単位で攻撃方向を変える。高速前蹴り、回し蹴り、足払い、掌底、肘、受け流し、崩し、投げへの入り、短距離突進などをランダムに組み合わせる。男性も本気で攻撃を返すが、主人公は直前で回避し、別方向へ抜ける。主人公が複数人に増殖したようには見せず、1人の人物が超高速で位置を変えているように描く。この区間では攻防の流れで2人が通路、路地、フロアなどをさらに移動し、背景が段階的に変化する。通行人や客がいる場合は、戦いを避けるように自然に脇へ下がり、進路が開く。カメラも後退しながら受けたり、横へ動いたり、回り込んだりして空間の変化を見せる。

8.4〜8.7秒。第5高速キッス。激しいラッシュの途中で突然真正面へ実体化。顔の超接近アップ。キッス。その瞬間だけ背景と人物の速度感が止まり、唇の接触が鮮明に見える。即離脱。

8.7〜10.5秒。高速格闘へ即復帰。男性が大きく反撃し、主人公が紙一重でかわす。さらに中国拳法、柔道、キック系などから別の技を高速で組み合わせる。この区間にテンポを壊さない範囲で第6高速キッスを短く1回追加してもよい。その場合も必ず「顔の超接近アップ → 短い接触 → 即離脱」で処理する。この区間でも2人はその場にとどまらず、押し引きしながら戦いの位置が少しずつ移動し続ける。カメラも追い続ける。

10.5〜12.5秒。一度だけ両者の距離が開く。男性は体勢を整え、本気で最後の攻撃に備える。主人公も静かに構える。2人とも相手から視線を外さない。ここだけ短い緊張の間を作る。ただし長く止まりすぎない。この時点ですでに開始地点とは違う位置まで戦いが移動していることが背景から分かる。カメラは少し回り込みながら2人の距離感を見せる。

12.5〜13.4秒。主人公が突然真正面から猛烈な速度で突進。強い残像を引きながら一気に距離を詰める。男性も迎撃しようとするが、その攻撃をかわしながら顔の目前まで到達。直前で完全急停止。ここでも2人はさらに数歩分位置を移し、カメラも一緒に踏み込む。

13.4〜13.9秒。フィニッシュ高速キッス。顔の超接近アップ。最後のキッスはそれまでよりわずかに長く、最も明確に見せる。直前まで超高速だった映像が、この瞬間だけ完全に静止したように見える。恋愛的な演出は一切入れない。真剣な必殺技として扱う。

13.9〜15.0秒。キッス直後、男性が強い衝撃を受けて後方へ大きく吹き飛ぶ、転倒する、床を滑る、壁や什器の方向へ弾かれるなど、ロケーションに合わせた真剣な決着。過剰なギャグ落ちは不要。主人公はその場付近に残り、静かに男性を見る。笑顔、勝利ポーズ、指差し、コミカルな仕草はしない。カメラは決着の勢いに合わせてわずかに流れ、最後に止まる。

高速移動の表現は「急加速 → モーションブラーと残像 → 一瞬だけ実体化 → 鮮明な技またはキッス → 即再加速」を繰り返す。高速中ずっと人物をぼかし続けず、停止した瞬間だけ身体と顔を鮮明にする。主人公が複数人に見えないようにする。常に同一人物1人が高速移動しているように見せる。

カメラは実写映画の格闘シーンとして撮影する。基本はミディアム〜ワイドで、2人の位置関係と技の動線を明確にする。高速移動中は短いパン、急なリフレーム、わずかに遅れる追従、自然な手持ち感、前進、後退、横移動、回り込みを使う。カメラそのものを無意味に高速回転させない。

キッスの瞬間だけ必ず顔の超接近アップへ切り替える。「ワイドで高速格闘 → 突然顔の超アップ → 0.2〜0.4秒のキッス → 即ワイドへ戻って高速格闘」という映像テンポを何度も繰り返す。このアップとワイドの高速な切り替えが映像の重要なリズム。さらに各ワイド、ミディアム、アップの撮影位置や背景は少しずつ変化し、同じ場所、同じ画角、同じ背景で繰り返さない。

登場人物は最後まで真剣。ふざけない。笑わない。キッスだけをギャグとして強調しない。全体としては緊迫した本格高速格闘映画であり、その中に説明不能な高速キッス技が何度も自然に組み込まれている状態を維持する。

毎回ランダムに変更するのは、ロケーション、背景人物、格闘技、技の順番、男性の反撃、戦いながら移動する方向と経路、カメラが追従する方向と角度、最後の決着方法。

毎回必ず維持するのは、参照画像1の女性主人公、参照画像2の男性対戦相手、2人の同一性、35mm映画フィルム調のシネマティックな映像、本気の高速格闘、0.2〜0.4秒単位の高速アクション、最低5回程度の高速キッス、キッスごとの顔の超接近アップ、キッスだけ一瞬完全停止、キッス直後の即高速離脱、即格闘復帰、最後の高速キッスによるフィニッシュ、戦いながら少しずつ空間を移動し続けること、カメラも固定せず戦いと一緒に追従して移動し続けること。
